item.title: Mera Pitha
item.description: A recipe for mera pitha
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make traditional mera pitha very easily.

Ingredients

  • Rice flour (500 g / 2 cups)
  • Date palm jaggery or sugar (1 cup, for sweetness)
  • Grated coconut (1 cup)
  • Water (2 cups, or as needed)
  • Salt (1/2 teaspoon, or to taste)

Method

In a pot, bring water, salt, and jaggery (if using) to a boil. When the water is boiling, add the grated coconut. Then stir in the rice flour, lower the heat, and cover for 2–3 minutes so the flour cooks through. Remove from the heat and, when cool enough to handle, knead it by hand into a smooth dough.

Take small portions of the dough and, using both palms, shape them into small round or oval pithas. Arrange them in a steamer or steaming pot and steam for 20–25 minutes. Serve the mera pitha hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Rui Fish with Bottle Gourd Greens
item.description: A recipe for rui fish curry with bottle gourd greens
item.content:encoded:
Here is a delicious curry of rui fish with bottle gourd greens.

Ingredients

  • Rui fish (4–5 pieces)
  • Bottle gourd greens (500 g)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Green chilies (2–3)

Method

Rub the rui fish lightly with salt and turmeric, shallow-fry until lightly colored, remove the bones, and set aside in a bowl.

Wash the bottle gourd leaves and stems well and cut them into small pieces. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan and add the chopped onion. When the onion turns light golden, add turmeric, chili powder, and salt to taste and stir. Once the masala is fried, add the bottle gourd greens and cook for 5–7 minutes. When the stems are mostly tender, add the deboned fried rui fish and cook for about 5 more minutes. Add a few green chili strips 2–3 minutes before taking the pan off the heat.

Serve hot.

item.title: Jackfruit Seed Mash
item.description: A tasty jackfruit seed mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a delicious jackfruit seed mash.

Ingredients

  • Jackfruit seeds (250 grams)
  • Dried chilies (4–5)
  • Dried shrimp (100 grams)
  • Onion (1)
  • Garlic (5–6 cloves)
  • Mustard oil (to taste)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Cilantro (to taste)

Method

First, shell the dried jackfruit seeds and roast them well in a griddle or skillet. Roast over low heat for a longer time so the centers are fully cooked.

Heat mustard oil in a pan and fry the dried shrimp, diced onion, garlic, dried chilies, and salt to taste until fragrant. Add the jackfruit seeds midway through frying.

Transfer the fried mixture and fresh cilantro to a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. Your delicious jackfruit seed mash is ready. Serve hot with rice.

item.title: Loitta Dried Fish Bhuna
item.description: A tasty loitta dried fish bhuna recipe
item.content:encoded:
Living abroad, you always crave dried fish. Here is how to make a simple, mouth-watering loitta dried fish bhuna.

Ingredients

  • Loitta dried fish (250 grams)
  • Garlic (4–5 cloves)
  • Diced onion (1 cup)
  • Dried chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (2 tablespoons)

Method

First, remove the tails and scales from the dried fish and cut it into small pieces. Rinse well and soak in water for half an hour.

Heat oil in a pan and fry the dried fish and garlic cloves. Set them aside, add a little more oil to the same pan, and add diced onion and dried chilies. When the onion softens slightly, add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt, and sauté until the spices are fragrant. Add the fried fish and garlic back in and cook over low heat for another 10–15 minutes, stirring well. Add split green chilies 2–3 minutes before taking off the heat.

Serve hot with rice.

item.title: Banana Pitha
item.description: A recipe for banana pitha
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make banana pitha very easily.

Ingredients

  • Rice flour (375 g / 1.5 cups)
  • All-purpose flour (125 g / 0.5 cup)
  • Ripe bananas (2)
  • Milk (1 cup)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Sugar (1.5 cups)
  • Baking powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

First, blend the milk, eggs, bananas, sugar, and baking powder until smooth. Then add the rice flour, all-purpose flour, and salt and mix until you have a thick pitha batter.

Heat oil in a pan and pour in small portions of the batter to form pithas. Fry until both sides are golden. Serve the banana pitha hot.

item.title: Garlic Sprout Chicken
item.description: A delicious garlic sprout chicken recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make the kind of garlic sprout chicken you would find in a Chinese restaurant.

Ingredients

  • Chicken breast (2)
  • Garlic sprouts (400 g)
  • Chopped garlic (1 tablespoon)
  • Soy sauce (1 tablespoon)
  • MSG (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili flakes (1 teaspoon)
  • Corn flour (1 teaspoon)
  • Sesame seeds (1 pinch)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Cut the chicken into small pieces and marinate with chili flakes, salt, and corn flour for 30 minutes. Cut the garlic sprouts into 2-inch pieces and blanch them in hot water for 1–2 minutes.

Heat a little oil in a large wok and fry the chicken. When it starts to color, add chopped garlic and stir briefly. Add the garlic sprouts, soy sauce, and MSG. Stir-fry everything on high heat for 3–4 minutes. Sprinkle sesame seeds over the top just before serving.

item.title: Kacchi Biryani
item.description: An incredibly delicious kacchi biryani recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is an easy and delicious kacchi biryani recipe.

Ingredients

  • Mutton (1 kg)
  • Potatoes (4–5)
  • Polao rice (4 cups)
  • Oil (1 cup)
  • Green chilies (6–7)
  • Sour yogurt (250 g)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Onion (1 cup)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala (2 teaspoons)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Nutmeg (1)
  • Mace (2–3 pieces)
  • Ghee (2 tablespoons)
  • Saffron (1 teaspoon)
  • Kewra water (1 teaspoon)
  • Milk (1/2 cup)
  • Flour (for sealing the pot)

Method

Wash the mutton, cut it into small pieces, and marinate with a little oil, 1 cup sour yogurt, turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, nutmeg-mace paste, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for 4–5 hours. Overnight marination for 8+ hours works best.

Fry the chopped onion until golden brown and set the beresta aside.

Peel and wash the potatoes, rub lightly with salt and turmeric, and deep-fry until golden. Set aside.

Boil enough water in a pot and parboil the polao rice until about 80% cooked. Drain and set aside.

In the pot you will cook the biryani in, layer the marinated mutton at the bottom. Top with the parboiled rice and the fried potatoes. Add fried onion, a few spoonfuls of ghee, kewra water, and saffron soaked in 1/2 cup milk for 30 minutes. Seal the pot well with a flour dough. Place it on the stove over full heat for 10 minutes. Then, without breaking the seal, bake in the oven at 180°C (350°F) for 1.5 hours.

Remove the biryani from the oven, break the seal, mix the rice with the mutton, and serve hot.

item.title: Chicken Potato Chop
item.description: A recipe for potato chop stuffed with chicken mince
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for potato chop filled with spiced chicken mince.

Ingredients

  • Potatoes (2 large)
  • Chicken mince (1 cup)
  • Finely chopped onion (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Red chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 teaspoon)
  • Ginger-garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala (1 teaspoon)
  • Breadcrumbs (1 cup)
  • Egg (1)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Mix the chicken mince with turmeric powder, red chili powder, chopped cilantro, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, and salt. Fry the mince in a pan with a little oil until cooked through.

Boil the potatoes and mash them with salt, chopped green chilies, the fried chicken mince, and chopped onion. Shape the mash into small chops like in the photo. Beat an egg in a bowl. Dip each chop in the egg, roll in breadcrumbs, and deep-fry over medium heat until golden brown. Serve hot.

item.title: Spicy Chicken Pasta
item.description: A Bengali-style spicy chicken pasta recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a fully Bengali-style spicy chicken pasta recipe.

Ingredients

  • Conchiglie pasta (200 g)
  • Chicken (200 g)
  • Chopped carrot (2 tablespoons)
  • Green peas (1 cup)
  • Tomato (1)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Onion (1)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Red chili powder (a little)
  • Ginger-garlic paste (a little)
  • Olive oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

Wash the chicken, cut it into strips, and marinate with salt, a little red chili powder, and a little ginger-garlic paste for 30 minutes.

Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 1 teaspoon salt. Add the pasta and cook according to the package directions, usually 10–12 minutes.

Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a pan and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add the chicken. Once the chicken is browned, add diced tomato, carrot, and green peas. Cook until the tomato breaks down.

Crack in 2 eggs and stir. Add the pasta and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve hot.

item.title: Akhni
item.description: Traditional Chittagong akhni biryani recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is the traditional Chittagong akhni biryani recipe.

Ingredients

  • Beef (1 kg)
  • Polao rice (3 cups)
  • Oil (1 cup)
  • Green chilies (6–7)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Onion (1 cup)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Cilantro paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Potato (1)
  • Carrot (1)
  • Green peas (1 cup)

Method

Wash the rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Then drain well.

Wash the beef, cut it into small pieces, and marinate with a little oil, ginger paste, garlic paste, cumin paste, cilantro paste, and salt for 30 minutes. Heat oil in a pot and fry chopped onion with cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and bay leaves. When the onion softens, add the meat and cook well. Add water and cook until tender. When the beef is done, stir in the drained rice. For 3 cups of rice, add 6 cups of hot water. At this stage add potato, carrot, and green peas. Stir well and cook until the water is mostly absorbed, then add green chilies. Reduce the heat to very low and let it steam on dum for 10 minutes. During that time, gently turn the akhni over 3–4 times. Serve hot.

item.title: Sillago Fish Chocchori
item.description: A recipe for cooking sillago fish chocchori
item.content:encoded:
Where I live, local fish is available but fresh fish is hard to find—almost everything is frozen. The only way to get truly fresh fish is from Chinese grocers. They carry sillago (Silver Sillago), which is hugely popular across Southeast Asia. This fish chocchori is very easy to make and tastes wonderful. I think you will love it too.

Ingredients

  • Sillago fish (500 g)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Chili powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (5–6)
  • Oil (2 tablespoons)
  • Tomatoes (2)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Cilantro (to taste)

Method

First, clean and cut the fish, then wash it well. In a pan, mix the fish with all the ingredients except the cilantro. Cover and cook over heat. This fish cooks quickly. After 7–8 minutes, stir the fish gently once—too much stirring will break it apart, so move it carefully. After another 5–6 minutes, when the fish is done, scatter chopped cilantro on top. Your delicious sillago fish chocchori is ready.

item.title: French Fries
item.description: Make delicious French fries with ease
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make delicious French fries.

Ingredients

  • Potatoes (2)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Chaat masala (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for deep-frying)

Method

Wash the potatoes well and peel them. Cut into French fry shapes. As you cut, drop them into cold water so excess starch does not stick to the surface. Drain and dry the potatoes thoroughly.

Heat oil in a pot over medium heat (150°C) and fry for 10–12 minutes. Drain and let the potatoes cool. At this stage the color should not have changed. If you want to freeze them for later, you can put them in the freezer now.

Fry again over high heat (190°C) for 4–5 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from the heat and immediately sprinkle with salt and chaat masala. Serve hot.

item.title: Chicken Ball
item.description: A recipe for delicious chicken balls
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make delicious chicken balls.

Ingredients

  • Boneless chicken (300 grams)
  • Corn flour (2 tablespoons)
  • Green chilies (3–4)
  • Garlic powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Bread crumbs (1/2 cup)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for deep-frying)

Method

Cut the boneless chicken into small pieces. Mix with salt, garlic powder, chopped green chilies, bread crumbs, and black pepper powder. In another bowl, dissolve 2 tablespoons of corn flour in 1/2 cup of water until smooth. Add the corn flour mixture to the chicken and marinate for 30 minutes.

Blend the chicken mixture well in a blender or food processor. Bring a pot of water to a boil, shape the mixture into small balls, drop them in, and poach until cooked. They do not need long—when the balls float to the surface, remove them and drain on paper towels. If you want to store them, cool and refrigerate at this stage.

Deep-fry the balls in hot oil until golden—they are already cooked, so they do not need long. Serve hot.

item.title: Carrot Cake
item.description: An easy recipe for delicious carrot cake
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious carrot cake very easily.

Ingredients

  • All-purpose flour (2 cups)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Eggs (4)
  • Butter (100 g)
  • Baking powder (24 g)
  • Baking soda (8 g)
  • Salt (1 pinch)
  • Grated carrot (1 cup)
  • Vanilla extract (10 ml)

Method

First, peel the carrots, wash them, and grate enough to make 1 cup. Squeeze out as much carrot juice as possible. Then combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt and mix well.

Separate the egg yolks from the whites. Beat the whites until foamy but not fully stiff, then set them aside.

In a large bowl, beat the yolks well. Add the sugar, butter, and vanilla extract and stir until the sugar dissolves. Sift the dry ingredients into the wet mixture a little at a time through a fine sieve, stirring until evenly combined. Once well mixed, gently fold in the reserved egg-white foam. You can use an electric mixer for the earlier steps, but fold in the foam with a spatula at this stage. Finally, gently fold in the grated carrot with a spatula.

Grease the baking pan thoroughly with butter. Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit the bottom, butter it, and place it in the pan. Bake in an oven preheated to 175°C for 35–45 minutes. Insert a toothpick into the cake to test it; the cake is done when the toothpick comes out clean. Remove it from the oven, cool for 10 minutes, then slice and serve.

item.title: Pumpkin Blossom Fritters
item.description: A recipe for pumpkin blossom fritters
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for delicious pumpkin blossom fritters.

Ingredients

  • Pumpkin blossoms
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Red chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Remove the pistils and stems from the pumpkin blossoms, then wash and drain them well. For the batter, add turmeric powder, red chili powder, black pepper powder, and salt to the gram flour. Add enough water to make a batter slightly thinner than pancake batter. Make sure there are no lumps. Dip the blossoms in the batter and deep-fry over medium heat until golden. Serve hot.

item.title: Orange Chicken
item.description: Crispy chicken coated in a sweet and tangy orange sauce
item.content:encoded:
Orange chicken is one of the most popular dishes at the American restaurant chain Panda Express. Here is how to make it at home.

Ingredients

  • Chicken breasts (2)
  • Orange juice (1 cup)
  • Soy sauce (1 tablespoon)
  • Sugar (1/2 cup)
  • All-purpose flour (1/2 cup)
  • Cornstarch (1 tablespoon)
  • Egg (1)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • MSG (to taste)
  • Finely chopped garlic (1 teaspoon)
  • Finely chopped ginger (1 teaspoon)
  • Sesame seeds (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili flakes (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for deep-frying)

Method

Wash the chicken and cut it into small cubes. Add salt, a little soy sauce, half the garlic, and the egg, then marinate for 30 minutes. Coat the chicken with the flour and 2 teaspoons of the cornstarch. Deep-fry until golden.

For the sauce, heat a little oil in a wok or frying pan. Add the chili flakes, ginger, and remaining garlic. Fry for about a minute, then add the orange juice, remaining soy sauce, sugar, and MSG. Mix the remaining 1 teaspoon of cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of water and add it to thicken the sauce. Once thickened, add the fried chicken and toss until evenly coated. Sprinkle with sesame seeds, stir, and serve.

item.title: Bibikhana Pitha
item.description: A recipe for traditional bibikhana pitha
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make traditional bibikhana pitha.

Ingredients

  • Rice flour (375 g / 1.5 cups)
  • All-purpose flour (125 g / 0.5 cup)
  • Condensed milk (250 ml)
  • Date palm jaggery (1 cup)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Sugar (2 tablespoons)
  • Grated coconut (1 cup)
  • Baking powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (1/2 teaspoon)

Method

First, mix the rice flour, all-purpose flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder together until there are no lumps. Beat the 2 eggs well in a pot. Add the condensed milk and date palm jaggery and mix; add a little water if needed. Stir in the grated coconut. Then add the dry ingredients and mix well. The batter should be about as thick as pancake batter. Cover and let it rest for 30 minutes. If you used packaged rice flour or grated coconut, mix in another half cup of milk and rest for an additional 30 minutes so the coconut and rice flour can absorb the liquid properly.

Traditionally this pitha is baked covered in a water bath. You can also bake it in the oven without a water bath. Bake at 175°C for 35–40 minutes. Serve once baked.

item.title: Achari Eggplant
item.description: Achari eggplant recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a delicious achari eggplant recipe.

Ingredients

  • Eggplant (2)
  • Potatoes (2)
  • Tomatoes (2)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Panch phoron (1 teaspoon)
  • Dried chilies (3)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Mustard oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Wash the potatoes and eggplant and cut them separately into cubes.

Heat mustard oil in a pot. Add the dried chilies and chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add turmeric, chili powder, panch phoron, cumin, and ginger-garlic paste. Stir well. Add a little water and keep frying the masala. When the masala is done, add the potatoes. Once the potatoes begin to soften, add the diced tomatoes. Then add the eggplant. When everything is cooked through, stir in the roasted cumin powder.

Serve hot.

item.title: Sesame Coconut Naru
item.description: A recipe for delicious sesame and coconut jaggery naru
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious sesame coconut naru.

Ingredients

  • Grated coconut (200 g)
  • Sesame seeds (100 g)
  • Jaggery (2 cups)
  • Coconut milk (100 ml)
  • Milk (100 ml)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Bay leaf (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Puffed rice flour (2 tablespoons)

Method

First, toast the sesame seeds in a pan over low heat, stirring constantly.

This recipe needs a generous amount of jaggery. Use 1 cup of jaggery for every 100 g of grated coconut.

Combine the coconut milk and milk in a pot with the cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf, and jaggery. When the jaggery melts, add the grated coconut. Keep stirring until the milk evaporates and the mixture is no longer sticky. When the mixture is nearly dry, add the toasted sesame seeds. Remove from the heat and let it cool slightly.

Finally, shape the mixture into round naru and roll them in puffed rice flour so they do not stick together. Serve.

item.title: Shol Fish Bhuna
item.description: A recipe for shol fish bhuna
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for delicious shol fish bhuna.

Ingredients

  • Large shol fish (1)
  • Tomato (4)
  • Chopped onion (2 cups)
  • Turmeric powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Chili powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (5–6)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, clean and wash the shol fish well, cut it into pieces, rub lightly with turmeric, and shallow-fry. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add all the spices except the green chilies and fry well, adding a little water if needed. Then add large cubed tomato. When the tomato softens, add the fried shol fish and cook for 5–7 minutes. Just before serving, add green chilies sliced lengthwise and chopped cilantro.

item.title: Taro Stems with Prawns
item.description: A simple but delicious prawn curry with taro stems
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for a delicious prawn curry with taro stems.

Ingredients

  • Taro stems (1/2 kg)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Garlic (1–2 cloves)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Ginger paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Prawns (20–25)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the taro stems well and cut them into pieces. Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add chopped garlic. A little later, add ginger paste, garlic paste, turmeric powder, chili powder, salt, and a splash of water, and fry the spices until fragrant. Add the washed prawns and cook for 8–10 minutes. Then add the cut taro stems and cook until tender, adding a little water if needed. The taro stems will be done in 7–8 minutes. Add green chilies 2–3 minutes before taking the pot off the heat. When the gravy has reduced and coats the curry nicely, serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Ash Gourd and Egg Stir-fry
item.description: An easy ash gourd and egg stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make an easy ash gourd and egg stir-fry.

Ingredients

  • Ash gourd (1)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, wash the ash gourd, peel it, and dice it. You can also grate it if you prefer. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. Add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt, stir well, then add the ash gourd. Keep stirring, then cover after a few minutes.

You do not need to add extra water — the ash gourd will release plenty of moisture and cook in its own juices. Wait until the liquid dries up. When it is nearly dry, add a few green chilies split down the middle. Break in 2 eggs and mix well. Stir for a few minutes until the eggs are fully cooked, then take off the heat.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Baila Fish Bhuna
item.description: A recipe for baila fish bhuna
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for delicious baila fish bhuna.

Ingredients

  • Baila fish (4 large)
  • Tomato (4)
  • Chopped onion (2 cups)
  • Turmeric powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Chili powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (5–6)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, clean and wash the baila fish well, cut each fish into 2–3 pieces, rub lightly with turmeric, and shallow-fry. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add all the spices except the green chilies and fry well, adding a little water if needed. Then add large cubed tomato. When the tomato softens, add the fried baila fish and cook for 5–7 minutes. Just before serving, add green chilies sliced lengthwise and chopped cilantro.

item.title: Vegetarian Taro Greens
item.description: A delicious and healthy vegetarian taro greens recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a quick look at a traditional vegetarian taro greens recipe.

Ingredients

  • Taro greens with stems (500 grams)
  • Onion (1)
  • Garlic (15–20 cloves)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Dried chilies (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, wash the taro greens with stems and cut them into small pieces. Put 1/4 cup of water in a pot along with garlic cloves, green chilies, taro greens, and salt to taste, and steam over the heat. The taro will soften within a few minutes and reduce considerably in volume. Mash the taro well with a spatula. Once the water dries up, transfer to a bowl and set aside.

Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion and dried chilies. When the onion turns golden, add turmeric and chili powder and sauté briefly. Add the cooked taro and stir-fry over medium heat for a long time until almost no moisture remains. When the taro greens are fully stir-fried, take off the heat and serve hot with rice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Okra Chorchori
item.description: An easy and delicious okra chorchori recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a delicious okra chorchori recipe.

Ingredients

  • Okra (250 g)
  • Tomato (1)
  • Onion (1)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Cilantro (for serving)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

Wash the okra well and cut it into large pieces. Toss with a little salt and turmeric and fry over high heat for 2–3 minutes. The okra does not need to be fully cooked at this stage—just enough to color the surface. Set it aside in a bowl.

Heat oil in a pan and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add turmeric, chili powder, and salt and fry the masala. Then add one tomato, cut into pieces. When the tomato softens, add the fried okra. Cover and cook for 2–3 minutes. Remove the lid, add green chili strips and chopped cilantro, and cook for another 2–3 minutes. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Malai Chop
item.description: An easy recipe for malai chop made with milk powder
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make malai chop very easily using milk powder.

Ingredients

  • Milk powder (1 cup)
  • Egg (1)
  • Baking powder (1/4 teaspoon)
  • Sugar (2 cups)
  • Cardamom (5–6)
  • Ghee (1 tablespoon)
  • Milk (1.5 liters)
  • Saffron (1/4 teaspoon)
  • Chopped almonds (for serving)

Method

First, combine the milk powder and baking powder in a pot with the ghee and a well-beaten egg. Knead it well for 10–15 minutes. Make sure the dough is very smooth and lump-free. Shape the sweets into diamond (chamcham) forms. Keep in mind that these sweets will double in size after cooking, so shape them accordingly.

In a pot, heat 1.5 liters of milk with 2 cups of sugar, a little saffron, and a few cardamom pods. When the milk comes to a boil, add the sweets. Cook over high heat for 5 minutes. Then cook over medium heat for another 20 minutes. Once cooled, sprinkle chopped almonds and saffron on top and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Muri Ghonto
item.description: A recipe for muri ghonto with rui fish head and mung dal
item.content:encoded:
Here is a mouthwatering recipe for muri ghonto.

Ingredients

  • Large rui fish head and tail
  • Mung dal (1.5 cups)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Star anise (1, optional)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

First, rub the rui fish head and tail lightly with salt and turmeric and shallow-fry. You can remove the tail bones after frying if you like.

Dry-roast the mung dal in a pan, taking care not to burn it. Let it cool, soak in water for 30 minutes, drain, and transfer to a bowl.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add all the spices except the green chilies and roasted cumin powder, one at a time. Watch that the spices do not burn; add a little water if needed. When the spices are fried, add the dal and cook it with the spices a little longer. Then add water. When the dal is half done, add the fried fish. Stir well and break the fish pieces as you go. When the dal is fully cooked, add green chilies 4–5 minutes before taking the pot off the heat. Finish with roasted cumin powder and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chicken Biryani
item.description: An incredibly delicious chicken biryani recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious chicken biryani.

Ingredients

  • Whole chicken (1)
  • Polao rice (4 cups)
  • Oil (1 cup)
  • Green chilies (6–7)
  • Sour yogurt (250 g)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Onion (1 cup)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala (2 teaspoons)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Nutmeg (1)
  • Mace (2–3 pieces)

Method

Cut and wash the chicken into small pieces. Marinate with a little oil, 1 cup sour yogurt, turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, nutmeg-mace paste, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for 30 minutes to 1 hour. In a separate pot, wash the polao rice well and drain.

In a pan, heat oil and fry most of the chopped onion until golden brown. Set half of the fried onion aside. Add half of the cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and bay leaves to the remaining fried onion in the pan, then add all of the marinated chicken. Cook well until the chicken is tender. Chicken usually does not take very long. When done, set the chicken aside.

In another pot, heat oil with the reserved chopped onion and the remaining whole spices. When the onion softens, add the polao rice and fry well. When the rice is toasted, add water. For 4 cups of rice, I use 12 cups of water. You can also use 10 cups water and 2 cups milk. When the rice is nearly cooked, add the prepared chicken and its gravy. Stir well and cook until the water is fully absorbed. Add 6–7 whole green chilies, stir, and let it steam on dum for 10 minutes. During those 10 minutes, gently turn the biryani over 3–4 times. Finish by sprinkling fried onion over the top and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Pan Pizza
item.description: An easy recipe for making pan pizza at home
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make pan pizza easily at home.

Ingredients

  • All-purpose flour (450 grams)
  • Active dry yeast (16 grams)
  • Salt (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Sugar (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Olive oil (2 tablespoons, plus a little for greasing the pan)
  • Bell pepper (1)
  • Chicken (150 grams)
  • Cherry tomatoes (10–12)
  • Mozzarella cheese (250 grams)
  • Tomatoes (4)
  • Onion (1)
  • Garlic (2 cloves)
  • Oregano (1 teaspoon)
  • Rosemary (1/4 teaspoon)
  • Thyme (1/4 teaspoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili flakes (1/4 teaspoon)

Method

To make the dough, combine 370 ml of lukewarm water with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, 1/4 teaspoon of sugar, and the active dry yeast in a bowl. Wait about 5 minutes—if bubbles form, the yeast is alive. Add 450 grams of flour and 1/2 teaspoon of salt and mix well. This is a high-hydration dough, so it will be sticky. After kneading for 8–10 minutes, shape into a ball and rest at room temperature for 1 hour, covered, so the dough does not dry out.

Meanwhile, make the pizza sauce. Score 4 tomatoes and boil them in water for 3–4 minutes until the skins loosen. Blend the tomatoes. In a pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sauté chopped onion and garlic. When they start to turn golden, add the blended tomatoes. Add rosemary, oregano, thyme, black pepper powder, chili flakes, the remaining 1/4 teaspoon of sugar, and salt to taste. Cook until the sauce thickens, then set aside.

After 1 hour the dough will have doubled. Knead again for 5 minutes, then cover and rest for 30 minutes. The dough is now ready for pizza.

Grease a baking pan well with olive oil. Press the dough out with your fingertips to cover the pan. You can shape it however you like—I used a square pan, so I made a Detroit-style square pizza. Spread the sauce on top, then add grated mozzarella cheese. Add toppings—I used thin chicken strips, cherry tomatoes, and bell pepper. Use whatever toppings you prefer.

Bake in a preheated oven at 250°C for 12–15 minutes. Your homemade pan pizza is ready. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Date Palm Jaggery Sandesh
item.description: A recipe for traditional date palm jaggery sandesh
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make mouthwatering date palm jaggery sandesh.

Ingredients

  • Milk (1/2 liter)
  • Date palm jaggery (250 g)
  • Milk powder (250 g)
  • Cardamom (3–4)

Method

First, heat half a liter of milk in a pot with 3–4 cardamom pods. When the milk reduces by about half, remove the cardamom. Add the date palm jaggery and keep stirring until it melts completely into the milk. When the mixture thickens, add half of the milk powder and stir until there are no lumps. Once fully combined, add the remaining milk powder the same way. When the mixture has thickened, remove it from the heat.

After a little while, when the mixture is moderately cool, shape it with a cookie cutter, mold, or your palms into different forms. Serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Tomato and Hyacinth Bean Seed Curry
item.description: An easy recipe for a distinctively flavored tomato and hyacinth bean seed curry
item.content:encoded:
Here is an easy recipe for a tomato curry with hyacinth bean seeds.

Ingredients

  • Hyacinth bean seeds (400 g)
  • Tomatoes (3)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Ginger paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, soak the hyacinth bean seeds in water for 5–6 hours. This softens the skins. Then peel off all the skins and transfer the seeds to a bowl.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion, ginger paste, and garlic paste. When the onion turns soft and starts to brown, add salt, turmeric, and chili powder. Add a little water if needed so the spices do not burn. Once the masala is fried, add the hyacinth bean seeds and diced tomatoes. Cook for about 10 minutes. Add water, cover, and simmer until the seeds are tender. Top with a few green chili strips and cook for another 2–3 minutes before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Punjabi Dish: Rajma
item.description: A recipe for delicious Punjabi rajma dal
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make rajma dal, one of Punjab's most popular dishes.

Ingredients

  • Rajma/kidney beans (1 cup)
  • Tomatoes (3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Whole cumin seeds (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic (2–3 cloves)
  • Cardamom (2–3)
  • Cinnamon (2–3 sticks)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Cilantro (to taste)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (as needed)

Method

Wash the beans well and soak in water for 6–8 hours. In a pot, add the beans with water, salt, cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaves. Cook until completely soft.

Heat oil in another pot and add whole cumin seeds and chopped onion. When the onion softens, add chopped garlic. Once the onion turns golden, add all the spices and chopped tomatoes and cook until the masala is well fried. Add the cooked beans with their cooking liquid. Add 2 green chilies split lengthwise. Cook for 10–15 minutes until the liquid reduces and the dal becomes thick. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve.

Nothing compares to hot rajma with roti, rice, or paratha.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Steamed Pitha
item.description: An easy recipe for steamed pitha
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make steamed pitha using store-bought rice flour.

Ingredients

  • Rice flour (500 g)
  • Milk (100 ml)
  • Date palm jaggery (1 cup)
  • Grated coconut (1 cup)
  • Salt (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Sugar (1/2 teaspoon)

Method

First, combine the rice flour, half a teaspoon of sugar, and half a teaspoon of salt in a large bowl. Add lukewarm milk and knead well. Since we are using dry store-bought rice flour, this step is very important; otherwise the pithas will fall apart. After mixing in the milk, the rice flour mixture should hold together when squeezed in your fist, yet crumble when pressed in the center.

If you have a steamer, use it to make the pithas. If not, tie a cheesecloth tightly over the mouth of a pot to make a steamer. Add water to the steamer and bring it to a boil. Once steam starts rising, the steamer is ready for the pithas.

In a small flat bowl, first add a layer of rice flour. Then add a layer of grated coconut, followed by a layer of chopped jaggery. Finally, top with another layer of rice flour and press lightly. Cover with another piece of cheesecloth, invert it, and place it on the steamer with a lid on top. The pithas will be ready in 4–5 minutes. Tap the side of a pitha; if it bounces back, it is done. Remove and serve hot.

Nothing compares to hot, steaming pitha on a misty winter morning.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Coconut Jaggery Naru
item.description: A recipe for delicious coconut jaggery naru
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious coconut jaggery naru for a snack.

Ingredients

  • Grated coconut (200 g)
  • Jaggery (2 cups)
  • Coconut milk (100 ml)
  • Milk (100 ml)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Bay leaf (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Puffed rice flour (2 tablespoons)

Method

This recipe needs a generous amount of jaggery. Use 1 cup of jaggery for every 100 g of grated coconut.

First, combine the coconut milk and milk in a pot with the cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf, and jaggery. When the jaggery melts, add the grated coconut. Keep stirring until the milk evaporates and the mixture is no longer sticky. Remove from the heat and let it cool slightly.

Finally, shape the mixture into round naru and roll them in puffed rice flour so they do not stick together. Serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Khirsa Puli
item.description: A recipe for delicious khirsa puli pitha
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make mouthwatering khirsa puli pitha.

Ingredients

  • Milk (2 liters)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Fragrant rice flour (2 tablespoons)
  • Rice flour (1.5 cups)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Cardamom (3)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (1)

Method

First, to make the khirsa, heat 2 liters of milk and reduce it. When the milk has reduced to about 1 liter, add the cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf, sugar, and 2 tablespoons of fragrant rice flour. Continue cooking over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the milk thickens into khirsa.

In a pot, combine the rice flour with 1 tablespoon of oil and enough water to make a dough. Roll the dough out thin like flatbread and cut it into small round pieces. Place khirsa in the center of each round, fold the two edges together to close it, and seal the edges by pressing with a fork.

Finally, deep-fry until golden and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Peyaju
item.description: An easy recipe for crispy peyaju
item.content:encoded:
Iftar never feels complete without peyaju. Here is an easy recipe for crispy onion fritters.

Ingredients

  • Red lentils (masoor dal) (1 cup)
  • Yellow split peas (khesari dal) (1/2 cup)
  • Finely chopped onion (1.5 cups)
  • Chopped green chilies (1–2 tablespoons)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Red chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Wash the lentils well and soak them for 8 hours. Then grind or blend them to a coarse paste.

In a bowl, take an equal amount of chopped onion and add all the spices, green chilies, cilantro, and salt. Mash with your hands and let sit for 5–10 minutes so the onion softens and releases some moisture. Add the lentil paste and mix thoroughly.

Heat oil in a pan. Over medium heat, drop spoonfuls of the mixture into the oil and fry until golden brown. Peyaju takes time to cook through — do not raise the heat to speed things up. If you do, the outside will brown too quickly while the inside stays raw. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Shahi Firni
item.description: A recipe for traditional shahi firni
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make traditional shahi firni with wedding-feast flavor.

Ingredients

  • Fragrant rice (1 cup)
  • Milk (1 liter)
  • Sugar (450 g)
  • Ghee (1 tablespoon)
  • Raisins (1/2 cup)
  • Cardamom (2–3)
  • Cinnamon (2–3 sticks)
  • Saffron (5 g)
  • Chopped pistachios (for serving)

Method

First, wash the fragrant rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes so it softens and swells. Then coarsely crush the rice and set it aside.

In a bowl, stir the saffron into a little warm milk. Cover and let it sit for 30 minutes.

In a pot, bring 1 cup of water to a boil with the crushed rice, cardamom, and cinnamon and cook until tender. When the water is nearly absorbed, add the milk, sugar, raisins, and saffron-infused milk. Cook over medium heat. Add the ghee. When the milk has thickened to a creamy firni consistency, pour it into a serving dish and let it set. Sprinkle chopped pistachios on top for serving.

Firni is usually served cold. Let the hot firni come to room temperature first, then chill it in the fridge before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Duck Bhuna
item.description: A delicious duck bhuna recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a mouthwatering duck bhuna recipe.

Ingredients

  • Duck (1 kg)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Star anise (1, optional)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Remove all the feathers from the duck skin very carefully. Cut the duck into pieces and wash well.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add all the spices one by one except green chilies and roasted cumin powder. Watch that the spices do not burn; add a little water if needed. When the masala is fried, add the duck and cook well. When the meat is well fried, add 1 cup of water and cover. When the liquid has mostly reduced and the duck is tender, add a few green chilies. Cover and cook for another 3–4 minutes. Sprinkle roasted cumin powder over the top before serving.

Nothing compares to this duck bhuna served hot with paratha.
item.author: Milon

item.title: French Toast
item.description: Make delicious French toast for breakfast in just a few simple steps
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make quick and easy French toast.

Ingredients

  • White sandwich bread (8 slices)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Buttermilk or heavy cream (150 ml)
  • Sugar (1 tablespoon)
  • Vanilla extract (1/4 teaspoon)
  • Salt (1 pinch)
  • Ground cinnamon (1 teaspoon)
  • Butter (for frying)

Method

First, prepare the custard. Add the eggs, cream, sugar, salt, vanilla, and cinnamon to a bowl, then whisk until well combined.

Melt a little butter in a frying pan. Dip both sides of one bread slice in the custard, then cook over medium heat until golden brown. Flip it once the first side is done. Repeat with the remaining bread. Serve the toast hot with a pat of butter and maple syrup.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chinese Spicy Tofu Fry
item.description: A recipe for delicious Chinese spicy tofu fry
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make delicious Chinese spicy tofu fry.

Ingredients

  • Tofu (500 grams)
  • Egg (1)
  • Corn flour (2 tablespoons)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garlic powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for deep-frying)

Method

Drain the tofu well. Press out excess water with a kitchen towel if needed—the drier the tofu, the better it fries. Rub salt over the tofu and let it sit for 30 minutes. This helps salt penetrate and draws out more water. Discard any excess liquid, then cut the tofu into bite-size pieces.

Beat 1 egg with salt in one bowl. In another bowl, mix corn flour, black pepper powder, chili powder, and garlic powder. Coat each piece of tofu in the corn flour mixture, dip in the egg, then coat again in the corn flour mixture. Deep-fry in medium-hot oil until golden brown. Serve hot with sweet and sour sauce.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chicken Polao
item.description: An incredibly delicious chicken polao recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make exceptional chicken polao easily using Radhuni chicken polao mix.

Ingredients

  • Chicken (1 kg)
  • Polao rice (2 cups)
  • Milk (1 cup)
  • Oil (1 cup)
  • Radhuni chicken polao mix (2 tablespoons)
  • Green chilies (6–7)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Sour yogurt (150 g)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Onion (1 cup)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)

Method

Wash the chicken and cut it as you would for roast. In a bowl, mix sour yogurt with a little turmeric powder, chili powder, and Radhuni chicken polao masala. Coat the chicken pieces well and marinate for 1 hour.

Heat oil in a pot and add 1/2 cup chopped onion. When the onion turns golden brown, add ginger paste, garlic paste, and salt to taste. Add the chicken with all the masala and yogurt mixture. Cook well. Then add 1 cup milk and cover. When the milk has mostly reduced and the chicken is fully tender, transfer the chicken pieces to one bowl and the gravy-masala to another.

In a separate pot, heat oil with some chopped onion, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and bay leaves. When the onion softens, add the polao rice and fry well. When the rice is toasted, add water. For 2 cups of rice, I use 4 cups of water. Cover the pot. After a while the water will absorb and the rice will be nearly cooked. Transfer half the polao to another bowl. Mix the remaining half well with the prepared chicken gravy and masala. Spread it evenly in the pot, top with the chicken pieces, and cover with the reserved plain polao. Let the whole dish steam on dum for 10–15 minutes.

Serve hot with boiled eggs.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Texan Chili
item.description: A recipe for delicious American Texas-style chili
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make Texas-style chili.

Ingredients

  • Ground beef (400 grams)
  • Chopped carrots (1/2 cup)
  • Chopped celery (1/2 cup)
  • Chopped tomatoes (1 cup)
  • Kidney beans (1 cup)
  • Chopped onions (1 cup)
  • Soy sauce (1 teaspoon)
  • Worcestershire sauce (1 teaspoon)
  • Paprika powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cayenne pepper powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Ginger powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Oregano (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Beef stock (2 cups)
  • Oil (as needed)

Method

Heat a little oil in a pan and add the ground beef. When the beef is browned and lightly golden, transfer it to a bowl.

In a large pot, heat oil and add chopped onions. When the onions soften slightly, add all the spices and sauces one by one, stirring well. Add chopped tomatoes. When the tomatoes soften, add the carrots and celery. Then add the browned ground beef. Cook, stirring constantly, for 5–7 minutes. Add the kidney beans and beef stock and cover.

Stir once or twice every 5–7 minutes. When most of the liquid has reduced, remove from the heat. This chili is wonderful served hot with creamy mashed potatoes.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Indian Dish: Dal Tadka
item.description: A recipe for delicious Indian dal tadka
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at the recipe for tadka dal—one of India's most popular dishes, served in nearly every restaurant across the country.

Ingredients

  • Red lentils (masoor dal) (1/2 cup)
  • Moong dal (1/4 cup)
  • Toor/arhar dal (1/4 cup)
  • Onion (1 large)
  • Dried chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Panch phoron (1 teaspoon)
  • Whole cumin seeds (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic (2–3 cloves)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (as needed)

Method

Mix all three types of dal, wash well, and soak in water for 30 minutes. Drain and cook with 2 cups of water and 1 teaspoon of turmeric powder until completely soft and the lentils have mostly broken down—this can take 30 minutes to 1 hour depending on the lentils. Add 2 green chilies while cooking and more water if needed. The cooked dal mixture should be about 2 cups in volume.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion and garlic. When the onion softens slightly, add whole cumin seeds, dried chilies, and panch phoron. When the onion turns golden brown, pour in the cooked dal. Cook for 2 more minutes, add salt to taste, and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
item.description: Chicken tikka masala recipe
item.content:encoded:
Nothing compares to chicken tikka masala with paratha. Here is the recipe.

Ingredients

  • Boneless chicken (500 g)
  • Sour yogurt (2 tablespoons)
  • Milk cream (1/2 cup)
  • Tomato puree (2 tablespoons)
  • Turmeric powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Chili powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Cumin powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Coriander powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Whole cumin (1 teaspoon)

Method

Cut the chicken into small cubes. Mix with half of the ground spices, ginger-garlic paste, salt, and sour yogurt. Cover and marinate for 30 minutes. Heat oil in a pan and fry the chicken pieces until lightly golden brown. Set aside.

In another pan, heat oil and add whole cumin. When it starts to sizzle, add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add the remaining ground spices and stir. Add a little water so the spices do not burn. Stir in the tomato puree for a beautiful red color. Add 1/2 cup cream, then the fried chicken tikka, and cook for 5–7 minutes. Serve hot with paratha.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Singara
item.description: A mouthwatering singara recipe
item.content:encoded:
Hot singara is enough to make anyone's mouth water. Here is a quick recipe.

Ingredients

  • Potatoes (2)
  • Carrot (1)
  • Green peas (1 tablespoon)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Panch phoron (1 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Red chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic (2–3 cloves)
  • Onion (1)
  • All-purpose flour (2 cups)
  • Nigella seeds (kalonji) (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (2 tablespoons, plus more for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

In a bowl, mix 2 cups flour with nigella seeds and salt. Add 2 tablespoons oil and rub it in. Add water a little at a time to make a fairly firm dough. Rub the dough with a little oil, cover, and rest for at least 30 minutes.

For the filling, heat oil and add 1 teaspoon panch phoron. After 30 seconds, add chopped onion and 2–3 cloves of minced garlic. Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt. Add the pre-cut potato and carrot cubes. Add a little water, cover, and cook. When the water is nearly absorbed and the vegetables are tender, add green peas and chopped green chilies. Cook a little longer. Mash a few pieces of potato and carrot with a spatula so the filling becomes thick and cohesive. Remove from the heat and let cool.

Divide the dough into 8–10 equal portions. Roll each portion into a slightly elongated shape and cut it in half. Each half makes one singara. Wet one corner of a half-circle with water and form a cone. Fill with some of the mixture, wet the edges, and seal. You can freeze these for up to a month.

Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Do not fry on high heat — the outside will burn while the inside stays raw. Fry for 15–20 minutes over medium heat until golden brown. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Mushroom Stir-fry
item.description: A delicious and nutritious mushroom stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
We've had plenty of heavy meals — now let's turn to something healthier. Here is how to make mushroom stir-fry.

Ingredients

  • Potato (1)
  • Carrot (1)
  • Mushroom (500 grams)
  • Cumin seeds (1 teaspoon)
  • Diced onion (1/2 cup)
  • Minced garlic (1 tablespoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (2 tablespoons)

Method

First, peel and dice the potato, carrot, and mushroom into small cubes, then rinse them. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan and add whole cumin seeds. Add the diced onion. When the onion softens slightly, add the minced garlic, turmeric powder, and chili powder, followed by salt.

Now add the vegetables and keep stirring. You do not need to add water to mushroom stir-fry, because mushrooms release plenty of moisture on their own. Cover the pan with a lid. Once the released water dries up and all the vegetables are tender, add 2–3 green chilies split down the middle. Cook for another 3–5 minutes.

Done — a delicious and nutritious mushroom stir-fry. It tastes wonderful with hot whole-wheat roti.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Split Pea Halwa
item.description: A recipe for Old Dhaka's traditional split pea halwa
item.content:encoded:
On Shab-e-Barat, delicious split pea halwa is made in homes everywhere. You can make this wonderful dish any time you like. Here is the recipe.

Ingredients

  • Split peas (2 cups)
  • Ghee (1 cup)
  • Milk (4 cups)
  • Sugar (2 cups)
  • Cardamom (4–5)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (2)
  • Salt (1 pinch)
  • Chopped nuts (for serving)
  • Raisins (for serving)

Method

First, wash the split peas and soak them in water for 6–8 hours. Then in a pot, cook 2 cups of peas with 4 cups of milk along with the cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaf until tender. When the peas are cooked and the milk is nearly absorbed, mash or blend them into a paste.

In a large pot, heat 1 cup of ghee and fry the pea paste over medium heat. Stir constantly so it does not stick to the bottom. This step can take 20–30 minutes; keep stirring the whole time. When the paste is fried to a nut-brown color, there will be no raw smell left. At this stage, add 2 cups of sugar and mix well. Cook for another 2–3 minutes. The split pea halwa is ready.

While the halwa is still hot, spread it on a tray and cut it into pretty shapes with a knife, cookie cutter, or mold. Serve topped with chopped nuts and raisins.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chinese Dish: Chicken Corn Soup
item.description: A recipe for chicken corn soup, a popular item at Bangladeshi Chinese restaurants
item.content:encoded:
Chicken corn soup is one of the most popular items at Bangladeshi Chinese restaurants. Let's learn how to make it.

Ingredients

  • Boneless chicken (500 grams)
  • Chicken stock (6 cups)
  • Sweet corn kernels (150 grams)
  • Corn flour (3 tablespoons)
  • Soy sauce (1 tablespoon)
  • White vinegar (1 tablespoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Ajinomoto/MSG (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Eggs (2)

Method

Cut the chicken into thin strips. Marinate with 1 tablespoon of corn flour, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, MSG, and black pepper powder for 15–20 minutes.

In a large pot, bring the chicken stock to a boil and add the chicken and corn kernels. After a few boils, when the chicken is fully cooked, dissolve 2 tablespoons of corn flour in 1 cup of cold water and stir it in. Never add corn flour directly to hot soup—it will clump. Beat 2 eggs in a cup. Slowly pour the beaten eggs into the soup while stirring constantly. Cook for another 2–3 minutes, then serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Kashmiri Pink Tea
item.description: A recipe for exceptionally flavorful Kashmiri pink tea
item.content:encoded:
Here is a quick recipe for Kashmir's traditional pink tea.

Ingredients

  • Kashmiri tea leaves (2 tablespoons)
  • Salt (1 teaspoon)
  • Baking soda (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (5–6 pods)
  • Cinnamon (2–3 sticks)
  • Star anise (1)
  • Milk (1/2 liter)
  • Sugar (to taste)
  • Chopped pistachios (for serving)
  • Chopped cashews (for serving)

Method

In a pot, combine 2 cups of water with salt, baking soda, cardamom, cinnamon, star anise, and Kashmiri tea leaves. Bring to a boil. If you do not have Kashmiri tea leaves, you can use any green tea, though you may need a little more baking soda. When the liquid reduces to about 1 cup, add 2 more cups of ice-cold water. This helps develop the tea's flavor. When it reduces again to about 1 cup, strain the liquid into a bottle. This is your Kashmiri tea concentrate. You can refrigerate it and use it for 2–3 weeks.

Heat the milk in a pot. Once it comes to a boil, add the Kashmiri tea concentrate a little at a time. Stop adding concentrate once the milk turns fully pink. Traditionally this tea is served salted, but you can sweeten it with sugar if you prefer. Finish by sprinkling chopped pistachios and cashews on top and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Snack Recipe: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
item.description: An easy recipe for grilled cheese sandwich
item.content:encoded:
Here is a simple recipe for a delicious grilled cheese sandwich.

Ingredients

  • Bread
  • Cheese
  • Butter
  • Black pepper powder

Method

Butter one side of a slice of white sandwich bread. Place it butter-side down in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add a slice of cheese. Processed cheese is traditional for grilled cheese — I used American processed cheddar. Sprinkle a little freshly ground black pepper on top. Cover with another slice of bread and butter the top slice as well. Cook until both sides are golden brown. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Broken Rice / Bouya Rice
item.description: Traditional rural Bengali broken rice and bouya rice recipe
item.content:encoded:
Broken rice, also known as bouya rice, is a traditional Bangladeshi dish. Here is how to make it.

Ingredients

  • Broken polao or basmati rice (1 cup)
  • Onion (1 large)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 pieces)
  • Cloves (2)
  • Bay leaf (1)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (5–6)

Method

Wash the broken rice very well and drain.

Heat oil in a pan and add chopped onion and the whole spices. When the onion softens slightly, add the washed broken rice. Toast the rice over low heat. It will toast quickly. Keep hot water ready in another pot. When the rice is toasted, a wonderful aroma will rise. Add water using the rule of 3 cups water for every 1 cup of broken rice.

When the water has absorbed, reduce the heat to very low and spread 5–6 whole green chilies over the top. Bring the top layer to the bottom and the bottom layer to the top, then leave it on very low heat for 10 minutes. This is called giving it dum. During those 10 minutes, gently turn the rice over 3–4 times, bringing the top layer down and the bottom layer up. Your broken rice or bouya rice is ready.

Serve hot with a few vegetable bhartas and fried eggs.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Milk Powder Gulab Jamun
item.description: An easy recipe for gulab jamun made with semolina and milk powder
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make gulab jamun very easily using milk powder.

Ingredients

  • Milk powder (2 cups)
  • Semolina (3 tablespoons)
  • Baking powder (1/4 teaspoon)
  • Sugar (2 cups)
  • Cardamom (5–6)
  • Rose water (1 tablespoon)
  • Ghee (1 tablespoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Chopped pistachios (for serving)

Method

First, soak the semolina in 2 tablespoons of water for 10 minutes. Then add 2 cups of milk powder, 1/4 teaspoon of baking powder, and 1 tablespoon of ghee and knead into a dough. If the mixture feels a little dry, add 1–2 tablespoons of liquid milk as needed. Keep kneading until there are no lumps left. Shape the mixture into small balls.

For the sugar syrup, combine 2 cups of sugar with 2.5 cups of water and 5–6 cardamom pods in a pot over the heat. Stir well. When the sugar has completely dissolved, add the rose water and transfer the syrup to a bowl.

Heat oil in a pot and fry the sweets over medium heat. If you deep-fry them, they will float to the top within a few minutes. Keep frying until they are golden brown.

Once fried, soak the sweets in the sugar syrup for at least 1 hour. Then serve topped with a little chopped pistachio.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Indonesian Curry: Beef Rendang
item.description: A recipe for delicious Indonesian beef rendang curry
item.content:encoded:
In 2017, CNN Travel ran a poll to find the world's most delicious food. According to the results, Indonesian beef rendang was voted the world's tastiest dish. Let's learn that recipe today.

Ingredients

  • Beef (1 kg)
  • Coconut milk (1 liter)
  • Onions (2 large)
  • Dried chilies (5–6)
  • Ginger (2–3 pieces)
  • Garlic (7–8 cloves)
  • Cardamom (6)
  • Cinnamon (4–5 sticks)
  • Cloves (4–5)
  • Bay leaves (1–2)
  • Star anise (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Tamarind pulp (2 tablespoons)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Lemongrass (3–4 stalks)

Method

Set aside 1–2 dried chilies. Grind the remaining dried chilies, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaves, star anise, and all the ground spices together into a fine powder. Blend the onions, ginger, and garlic in a blender, then mix in the ground spices until well combined.

Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pot and add the spice paste. When the spices are lightly fried, add 2 tablespoons of tamarind pulp and salt to taste. Stir for 2–3 minutes, then add the beef cut into small pieces. Stir well. At this stage, add 1 liter of coconut milk and stir thoroughly. Reduce the heat to very low.

This dish needs to cook on very low heat for at least 3–4 hours. Stir every 10–15 minutes so it does not stick to the bottom. When the coconut milk has reduced by about half, add the lemongrass and the reserved dried chilies cut in half. The rendang is done when the liquid has evaporated and the curry is almost dry. Remove the lemongrass and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Coconut Naru
item.description: A recipe for delicious coconut naru
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious coconut naru for a snack.

Ingredients

  • Grated coconut (200 g)
  • Jaggery (1 cup)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Milk (100 ml)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Puffed rice flour (2 tablespoons)

Method

First, combine the milk with the cardamom, cinnamon, jaggery, and sugar in a pot. When the jaggery melts, add the grated coconut. Keep stirring until the milk evaporates and the mixture is no longer sticky. Remove from the heat and let it cool slightly.

Finally, shape the mixture into round naru and roll them in puffed rice flour so they do not stick together. Serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Rasmalai
item.description: A recipe for delicious rasmalai at home
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make shop-quality rasmalai at home very easily.

Ingredients

  • Chhana (2 cups)
  • Sugar (3 cups)
  • Corn flour (1 teaspoon)
  • Condensed milk (200 ml)
  • Milk powder (2 tablespoons)
  • Milk (1 liter)
  • Chopped pistachios and cashews (for serving)

Method

First, make chhana from 2 liters of milk. That should yield about 2 cups of chhana. You can find the chhana recipe here.

Mix 1 teaspoon of corn flour into the chhana and knead it well for 10–15 minutes. Make sure the chhana is very smooth. Then shape small sweets by rolling them between your palms.

In a large pot, combine 8 cups of water with 2 cups of sugar and bring it to a boil to make a syrup. Make sure the syrup is not too thick. Cook the sweets in it over high heat for 15–20 minutes. To test whether they are done, drop one sweet into a bowl of cold water. If it sinks, cooking is complete. If it floats, cook a little longer. Remove from the heat.

To make the malai, stir 2 tablespoons of milk powder and 200 ml of condensed milk into 1 liter of milk. When the milk comes to a boil, add 1 cup of sugar. If you like your sweets sweeter, you can add more. Lower the heat and keep stirring until the malai thickens.

Strain the sweets out of the sugar syrup and place them in a dish. Pour the malai over them. Sprinkle chopped pistachios and cashews on top. Let it cool. Once cold, refrigerate the sweets with the malai for 6–8 hours before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: German Dessert: Kaiserschmarrn
item.description: A recipe for delicious German kaiserschmarrn
item.content:encoded:
Kaiserschmarrn was a favorite dessert of Austrian Emperor Franz Joseph. In German, Kaiser means emperor and schmarrn means shredded. Let's learn how to make this delicious German shredded pancake.

Ingredients

  • All-purpose flour (1.5 cups)
  • Butter (1 tablespoon)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Milk (1 cup)
  • Sugar (2 tablespoons)
  • Baking powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Vanilla essence (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Icing sugar (1 tablespoon)

Method

Melt the butter. In a bowl, combine the melted butter with all ingredients except the icing sugar to make a fairly thin batter. Heat a pan very well and pour in the entire batter. Cook over medium heat. When bubbles form on the surface and no raw batter is visible on top, flip it over. After 2–3 minutes, tear the whole pancake into small pieces with a spatula.

Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with icing sugar while still hot. Serve with strawberry or raspberry jam.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chhana
item.description: An easy recipe for making chhana at home
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make chhana at home very easily.

Ingredients

  • Milk (1 liter)
  • Vinegar (4 tablespoons)

Method

First, heat the milk in a large pot. In a separate bowl, mix 4 tablespoons of vinegar with an equal amount of water and set it aside. When the milk comes to a boil, turn off the heat. Slowly add the vinegar-and-water mixture to the milk while stirring. Once everything is combined, wait 5 minutes. During this time the milk will curdle and the chhana will separate.

Now strain the mixture through a thin cotton cloth or cheesecloth and set the chhana aside. Rinse it lightly with a little water so there is no vinegar smell. Tie the chhana in the cloth and hang it for 1–2 hours so the excess water drains away. Your chhana is ready. You can now use it to make all kinds of sweets.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Kacha Golla
item.description: An easy recipe for mouthwatering kacha golla
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make kacha golla at home very easily.

Ingredients

  • Chhana (2 cups)
  • Sugar (2 cups)
  • Condensed milk (200 ml)
  • Milk powder (2 tablespoons)

Method

First, make chhana from 2 liters of milk. That should yield about 2 cups of chhana. You can find the chhana recipe here.

Divide the chhana in half and set one portion aside. Knead the remaining chhana very well for 10–15 minutes to improve the texture. Then mix in 2 cups of sugar thoroughly. Put the chhana-and-sugar mixture in a pot over the heat. Add 200 ml of condensed milk. Keep stirring until the mixture dries out completely.

Now combine this cooked mixture with the chhana you set aside earlier and knead for another 10–15 minutes. Finally, shape it into round balls. Spread 2 tablespoons of milk powder on a plate and roll the balls in it. Serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Vanilla Cake
item.description: An easy recipe for delicious vanilla cake
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious vanilla cake very easily.

Ingredients

  • All-purpose flour (2 cups)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Eggs (4)
  • Butter (100 g)
  • Baking powder (18 g)
  • Baking soda (4 g)
  • Salt (1 pinch)
  • Condensed milk or cream (200 ml)
  • Vanilla extract (10 ml)

Method

First, combine the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt and mix well.

Separate the egg yolks from the whites. Beat the whites until foamy but not fully stiff, then set them aside.

In a large bowl, beat the yolks well. Add the sugar, butter, vanilla extract, and condensed milk or cream and stir until the sugar dissolves. Sift the dry ingredients into the wet mixture a little at a time through a fine sieve, stirring until evenly combined. Once well mixed, gently fold in the reserved egg-white foam. You can use an electric mixer for the earlier steps, but fold in the foam with a spatula at this stage.

Grease the baking pan thoroughly with butter. Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit the bottom, butter it, and place it in the pan. Bake in an oven preheated to 175°C for 35–45 minutes. Insert a toothpick into the cake to test it; the cake is done when the toothpick comes out clean. Remove it from the oven, cool for 10 minutes, then slice and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chocolate Cake
item.description: Bake a rich chocolate cake with this simple recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is an easy way to make a delicious chocolate cake.

Ingredients

  • All-purpose flour (2 cups)
  • Cocoa powder (3/4 cup)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Eggs (3)
  • Butter (100 g)
  • Baking powder (18 g)
  • Baking soda (4 g)
  • Salt (1 pinch)
  • Condensed milk or cream (200 ml)
  • Vanilla extract (3 ml)

Method

Combine the flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

In a large bowl, beat the eggs thoroughly. Add the sugar, butter, vanilla, and condensed milk or cream, then stir until the sugar dissolves. Sift the dry ingredients into the wet mixture a little at a time, stirring until evenly combined. Cover the high-hydration batter and let it rest for 15 minutes for a better result.

Grease the baking pan thoroughly with butter. Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit the bottom, butter it, and place it in the pan. Bake in an oven preheated to 175°C for 35–45 minutes. Insert a toothpick into the cake to test it; the cake is done when the toothpick comes out clean. Remove it from the oven, cool for 10 minutes, then slice and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chicken Patties
item.description: A recipe for delicious chicken patties
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for delicious chicken patties.

Ingredients

  • Boneless chicken (100 g)
  • Ginger paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)
  • Onion (1)
  • Black pepper powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Milk (1/2 cup)
  • All-purpose flour (1 tablespoon)
  • Puff pastry dough (1 roll)
  • Egg (1)

Method

Boil the chicken with ginger paste until tender. Shred the cooked chicken into small pieces and set aside. Heat oil in a pan and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add salt, black pepper powder, and flour. Stir well, then add the milk. Cook until the mixture thickens into a smooth filling, then remove from the heat.

Use store-bought puff pastry dough, or make your own. In German it is called Blätterteig. Cut the roll into four equal pieces. Place filling in the center of each piece, fold in half, and seal the edges. Once all the patties are folded, beat an egg and lightly brush it over the tops.

Bake in a preheated oven at 175°C (350°F) for 15–18 minutes. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Butternut Squash Stir-fry
item.description: Tasty butternut squash stir-fry with shrimp recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a tasty butternut squash stir-fry with shrimp.

Ingredients

  • Butternut squash (250 grams)
  • Shrimp (250 grams)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Onion (1)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Cilantro (to taste)

Method

First, wash the butternut squash and cut it into small pieces.

Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion softens slightly, add turmeric powder, chili powder, cumin powder, and salt, and sauté until fragrant. Add the shrimp and cook until well combined. Add the butternut squash. When the squash is tender, scatter green chilies and cilantro over the top, cook for a few more minutes, and take off the heat.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Kachki Fish Fritters
item.description: A recipe for fritters made with kachki fish
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for delicious fritters made with kachki fish.

Ingredients

  • Kachki fish (250 g)
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Finely chopped onion (2 cups)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Red chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Lemon juice (1 tablespoon)
  • Egg (1)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Cilantro (to taste)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

Wash the kachki fish thoroughly and drain well. Small fish often carry a lot of grit, so rinse them several times. Mix all the remaining ingredients together in a bowl.

Heat oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, drop spoonfuls of the mixture into the oil and fry until golden brown. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Snack Recipe: Tuna Sandwich
item.description: An easy recipe for tuna sandwich
item.content:encoded:
Here is a very easy recipe for a canned tuna sandwich.

Ingredients

  • Canned tuna (1 can — 190 g)
  • Hard-boiled egg (1)
  • Mayonnaise (2 tablespoons)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Black pepper powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Iceberg lettuce (1 head)
  • White sandwich bread

Method

Drain the tuna from the can and squeeze out the water. Pan-fry it in a skillet for 2–3 minutes. Grate a hard-boiled egg into the tuna and mix well. Add mayonnaise, salt, and black pepper and combine thoroughly.

Separately, shred and wash the iceberg lettuce.

Trim the crusts from square slices of white bread with a knife. Spread the filling on one slice, add some shredded lettuce, top with another slice, and cut into sandwich triangles. Serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Coconut Barfi
item.description: A recipe for delicious coconut barfi
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious coconut barfi for a snack.

Ingredients

  • Ghee (2 tablespoons)
  • Coconut paste (2 cups)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Cardamom (3)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (1)
  • Milk powder (1/2 cup)
  • Chopped nuts (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, heat ghee in a pot and add the cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaf. When the ghee is hot, add the coconut paste and fry it well. After 2–3 minutes, add the sugar. The sugar will melt quickly and the mixture will release water. Keep stirring constantly until the water evaporates. When the mixture has dried out, remove the whole spices, then add the milk powder and chopped nuts. Remove from the heat and, once slightly cool, cut into barfi squares. You can also set the mixture in a mold if you prefer.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Beef Chili Onion Curry
item.description: A recipe for delicious Chinese beef chili onion curry
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make the delicious beef chili onion curry found at Chinese restaurants.

Ingredients

  • Beef (250 grams)
  • Carrot (1)
  • Onions (4 large)
  • Green chilies (5–6)
  • Corn flour (1 tablespoon)
  • Curry powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (2 tablespoons)
  • Tomato sauce (2 tablespoons)
  • Soy sauce (2 teaspoons)

Method

Cut the beef into thin slices. Heat oil in a pot and add turmeric powder, chili powder, curry powder, and salt. Add the beef and a little water if needed. Cook until the beef is tender.

When the beef is done, add thinly sliced carrot and green chilies. Peel 4 large onions and cut each into 4 wedges. Add them to the pot and cook for a few minutes. Then add tomato sauce, soy sauce, salt to taste, and 1 tablespoon of corn flour dissolved in a little water. Stir and cook until the gravy reduces and becomes thick. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Turkish Scrambled Eggs: Menemen
item.description: A recipe for menemen, Turkey's traditional breakfast dish
item.content:encoded:
Menemen is Turkey's most popular breakfast dish—essentially a scrambled egg recipe. Let's learn how to make it easily.

Ingredients

  • Eggs (3)
  • Olive oil (2 tablespoons)
  • Onion (1)
  • Chopped tomatoes (3)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Black pepper powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Oregano (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chopped scallions (1/4 teaspoon)

Method

Heat olive oil in a pan and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add chopped tomatoes and green chilies. Cook until everything is soft and tender. After a few minutes, cook down the tomatoes until the mixture thickens.

In a separate bowl, beat 3 eggs with a pinch of salt. Pour the eggs into the tomato mixture and stir continuously. The eggs will cook within 2–3 minutes. Sprinkle with black pepper powder, oregano, and chopped scallions, and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Beef Kofta Curry
item.description: Beef kofta curry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious beef kofta curry.

Ingredients

  • Beef mince (1 kg)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Star anise (1, optional)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 teaspoon)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Mix the beef mince with ginger paste, garlic paste, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, chili powder, and half of the salt. Add chopped cilantro and chopped green chilies and mix very well. Shape the mince into small balls. Heat enough oil in a pot and deep-fry the meatballs until browned. Set them aside.

In another pot, heat oil and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaves, star anise, turmeric, and the remaining ginger paste, garlic paste, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala powder, chili powder, and salt. Watch that the spices do not burn; add a little water if needed. When the masala is fried, add the fried koftas and cook for another 5–7 minutes. Sprinkle roasted cumin powder over the top before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Kathi Kabab
item.description: Delicious kathi kabab recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious kathi kabab.

Ingredients

  • Beef mince (1 kg)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
