  • Garam masala powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1/2 cup)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 teaspoon)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

Mix the beef mince with all the spices until very well combined. Press the mince around skewers into long kabab shapes. Deep-fry the skewered kababs in hot oil and serve immediately.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Zucchini Stir-fry
item.description: Zucchini stir-fry with eggs recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a tasty zucchini stir-fry with eggs.

Ingredients

  • Zucchini (3 medium)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Scallion (1)

Method

First, peel, wash, and dice the zucchini into small cubes. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion softens slightly, add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Add the zucchini pieces and stir-fry well. The zucchini will release water and should cook in its own juices. If the liquid dries up but the zucchini is still not tender, you can add half a cup of water. Once the liquid evaporates, break in 2 eggs and mix thoroughly. Just before taking off the heat, add chopped scallion. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Achari Beef
item.description: Achari beef bhuna recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious achari beef bhuna.

Ingredients

  • Beef (1 kg)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Panch phoron (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 pieces)
  • Cloves (2)
  • Bay leaf (1)
  • Dried chilies (3)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Mustard oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Mango pickle (1 tablespoon)
  • Chopped ginger (1 teaspoon)

Method

First, wash the beef and cut it into medium-sized pieces.

Heat mustard oil in a pot. Add the chopped onion and cook until slightly softened. Then add turmeric powder, chili powder, panch phoron, cumin powder, coriander powder, cardamom, cinnamon, ginger-garlic paste, cloves, bay leaf, and dried chilies. Stir well and add a little water to fry the spices.

Once the spices are fried, add the beef and stir well. Keep the heat at medium. Add 1 cup of hot water, stir, and cover. Stir every 10 minutes until the beef is fully cooked. Season with salt to taste. When the beef is tender and the water has mostly evaporated, add garam masala powder, roasted cumin powder, and chopped ginger. Cook for another 2–3 minutes. At this stage you can add 1 tablespoon of mango pickle, though it is optional. The pickle does make the flavor even better.

Your achari beef bhuna is ready. It is wonderful with rice, khichuri, or paratha.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Fuchka
item.description: A recipe for delicious fuchka
item.content:encoded:
Fuchka is my favorite street food. Here is an easy recipe for making it at home.

Ingredients

  • Dried yellow peas (1 cup)
  • Baking soda (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chopped onion (1)
  • Dried red chili flakes (1 teaspoon)
  • Chotpoti spice mix (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Tamarind (250 g)
  • Chopped cucumber (for serving)
  • Chopped cilantro (for serving)
  • Chopped scallions (for serving)
  • Black salt (1 teaspoon)
  • Fuchka shells

Method

First, prepare the fuchka shells. I used store-bought shells for this recipe — fry them in deep oil at home and they are ready. You can make your own if you prefer.

Next, make ghugni. I already have a ghugni recipe on this site — you can find it here.

To make the tamarind water, soak the tamarind in 1 cup water for 15 minutes. Squeeze out the pulp and discard the seeds. Add water to reach your preferred thickness. Mix in black salt, table salt, dried red chili flakes, and chotpoti spice mix.

Make a small hole in each fuchka shell and fill it with ghugni. Top with a little chopped cucumber, onion, cilantro, and chotpoti spice mix. Serve with a bowl of tamarind water on the side.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chotpoti
item.description: A mouthwatering chotpoti recipe
item.content:encoded:
The street food I miss most abroad is chotpoti. Here is an easy recipe that hits all the right notes.

Ingredients

  • Dried yellow peas (2 cups)
  • Baking soda (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Tamarind (250 g)
  • Eggs (4)
  • Cucumber (1)
  • Radhuni chotpoti spice mix (1 packet)
  • Dried red chilies (10–12)
  • Green chilies (3–4)
  • Chopped cilantro (2 tablespoons)
  • Potatoes (2)
  • Onions (2)
  • Black salt (2 teaspoons)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Fuchka (20–25)

Method

First, prepare the fuchka. I used store-bought fuchka shells for this recipe — fry them in deep oil at home and they are ready. You can make your own shells if you prefer.

Hard-boil 4 eggs and chop them. Toast the dried red chilies in a pan and grind them into a powder.

To make the tamarind water, soak the tamarind in 1 cup water for 15 minutes. Squeeze out the pulp and discard the seeds. Add water to reach your preferred thickness. Mix in 1 teaspoon black salt, 1 teaspoon table salt, 1 teaspoon dried chili powder, and 1 tablespoon chotpoti spice mix. Add a little chopped cilantro if you like.

For the chotpoti base, rinse the peas and soak them overnight with 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Drain, rinse again, and boil in plenty of water. As they cook, loose skins will float to the top — skim them off with a spoon. When the peas are tender and the liquid has reduced to your preferred consistency, mash in 2 boiled potatoes. You can also add diced boiled potato instead.

In a bowl, combine the cooked peas with 1 teaspoon black salt, 2 teaspoons dried chili powder, 2 tablespoons chotpoti spice mix, 2 chopped hard-boiled eggs, 2 tablespoons tamarind water, salt to taste, 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro, and 1 chopped onion. Your chotpoti is ready.

To serve, spoon the mixture into a bowl. Top with a little chopped onion, cilantro, hard-boiled egg, green chili, and a pinch of chotpoti spice mix. Crush 3–4 fuchka shells over the top and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Radish and Prawn Curry
item.description: A simple but delicious radish and prawn curry
item.content:encoded:
In Germany and across Europe, small round red radishes are a very common vegetable. Here is a prawn curry made with them.

Ingredients

  • Red radish (500 g)
  • Tomato (4)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Prawns (20–25)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the radish and slice it thinly. Wash the tomatoes, cut them into small pieces, and set aside. Dust the prawns with a pinch of turmeric and shallow-fry them lightly in oil. Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. Then add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Add the radish and tomato, pour in enough water, and cover. The radish will soften quickly. Add the fried prawns and green chilies, stir for 2–3 minutes, and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Cauliflower and Carrot Stir-fry
item.description: A delicious and nutritious cauliflower and carrot stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a tasty mixed vegetable stir-fry with cauliflower and carrot.

Ingredients

  • Cauliflower (1 head)
  • Carrot (3)
  • Potato (1)
  • Green beans (1/2 cup)
  • Tomato (2)
  • Onion (1 large)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (2 tablespoons)

Method

First, wash all the vegetables except the tomatoes and cut them into small pieces. Wash the tomatoes, dice them into small cubes, and set aside in a separate bowl.

Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion turns lightly golden, add turmeric and chili powder and stir. Add all the vegetables, stir well, pour in about 1 cup of water, and cover. The vegetables will cook through and the liquid will evaporate within a few minutes. Season with salt to taste. Add the diced tomatoes and a few green chilies split down the middle, and cook for another 3–4 minutes. Remove from the heat and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Cauliflower Chop
item.description: A recipe for delicious cauliflower chop
item.content:encoded:
Here is an easy recipe for delicious cauliflower chop.

Ingredients

  • Cauliflower (1 head)
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Red chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Cut the cauliflower into large florets and wash them. Boil them in salted water until about 80% tender, then drain and set aside.

For the batter, add 1 teaspoon turmeric powder, 1/2 teaspoon red chili powder, and 1 teaspoon salt to the gram flour. Add enough water to make a mixture the consistency of pancake batter. Make sure there are no lumps. Dip the cauliflower florets in the batter and deep-fry over medium heat until golden brown. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Ridge Gourd Stir-fry
item.description: Ridge gourd stir-fry with eggs recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a tasty ridge gourd stir-fry with eggs.

Ingredients

  • Ridge gourd (2 medium)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Cilantro (for serving)

Method

First, peel, wash, and dice the ridge gourd. If the seeds have hardened, discard them. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion softens slightly, add the diced ridge gourd and 2–3 green chilies split down the middle, and keep stirring. You do not need to add water — the gourd releases plenty of moisture and will cook in its own juices. Season with salt to taste.

Once the liquid dries up, break in 2 eggs. Stir-fry for another 2–3 minutes. Add chopped cilantro just before taking off the heat. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Bottle Gourd Stir-fry
item.description: Bottle gourd stir-fry with eggs recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a tasty bottle gourd stir-fry with eggs.

Ingredients

  • Bottle gourd (1 medium)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Scallion (1)

Method

First, peel, wash, and dice the bottle gourd into small cubes. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion softens slightly, add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Add the bottle gourd pieces and stir-fry well. The gourd will release water, and it will cook in its own juices. Once the liquid dries up, break in 2 eggs and mix thoroughly. Just before taking off the heat, add chopped scallion. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Green Mango Jelly
item.description: A delicious and healthy green mango jelly recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for delicious, healthy green mango jelly.

Ingredients

  • Green mangoes (300 g)
  • Sugar (2 cups)
  • Lemon juice (2 teaspoons)
  • Green food coloring (1 pinch)

Method

Peel the green mangoes, remove the pits, cut into small pieces, and wash them. Boil in 500 ml water until very soft. Strain, reserving the cooking liquid separately. You can use the boiled mango pulp to make chutney if you like.

Measure the mango cooking liquid and return it to the pot. For every cup of liquid, add 1 cup sugar — I had 2 cups of liquid, so I used 2 cups sugar. Stir continuously until the sugar dissolves completely. Add 2 teaspoons lemon juice, which acts as a preservative. Add a pinch of green food coloring if you like — it is optional. Continue cooking until the mixture thickens to a syrupy consistency, then remove from the heat.

Pour the hot jelly into a glass container. Once cool, refrigerate. It keeps well in the fridge for about 6 months.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Hyacinth Bean and Potato Stir-fry
item.description: A tasty hyacinth bean and potato stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is an easy and tasty hyacinth bean and potato stir-fry recipe.

Ingredients

  • Potato (250 grams)
  • Hyacinth beans (250 grams)
  • Onion (1)
  • Cilantro (for serving)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, peel and dice the potatoes. Dice the hyacinth beans as well. Mix the potato and bean pieces together, rinse well, and drain.

Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion turns lightly golden, add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt, and stir once. Add the potatoes and beans and keep stirring. Add a little water if needed and cover. The beans and potatoes will soften within a few minutes. Split the green chilies and add them. Stir a couple of times and sprinkle cilantro just before serving.

This hyacinth bean and potato stir-fry is wonderful with hot roti or steaming rice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Italian Red Sauce Pasta
item.description: A recipe for delicious Italian red sauce pasta
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make delicious red sauce pasta.

Ingredients

  • Macaroni pasta (250 grams)
  • Canned tomatoes (1 can/400 grams)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Dried oregano (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (3–4)
  • Onion (1)
  • Garlic (2–3 cloves)
  • Olive oil (1 tablespoon)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Parmesan cheese (for serving)

Method

Bring a large pot of water to a boil with 1 teaspoon of salt. Add the pasta and cook according to the time on the package—usually 10–12 minutes. Drain the pasta.

Heat olive oil in a pot and add chopped onion and garlic. When the onion softens, add the entire can of tomatoes. Cook until the sauce reduces and thickens, then add salt, dried oregano, and chopped green chilies. Cook for 2–3 minutes, add the cooked pasta and chopped cilantro, and mix well. Garnish with grated Parmesan cheese and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Fried Papad
item.description: A recipe for crispy fried papad
item.content:encoded:
Here is an easy recipe for crispy fried papad.

Ingredients

  • All-purpose flour (1 cup)
  • Water (2 cups)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

In a bowl, mix the flour with salt and water until smooth. Use twice as much water as flour.

Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Place a stand inside the pot. Lightly oil a small plate, add a little of the flour mixture, and set the plate on the stand. Cover the pot. After a few minutes the mixture on the plate will set. Transfer it to a large tray lightly rubbed with oil. Repeat until all the mixture is used to make thin papad sheets. Dry them thoroughly — you can also dry them in the sun.

Finally, deep-fry each papad. They cook very quickly, usually in 15–20 seconds. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Minced Beef with Peas Bhuna
item.description: Beef mince bhuna with potato and green peas
item.content:encoded:
Here is a quick recipe for delicious beef mince bhuna with potato and green peas.

Ingredients

  • Beef mince (1/2 kg)
  • Potatoes (2)
  • Green peas (1 cup)
  • Tomato (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add all the spices except roasted cumin powder. When the masala is fried, add chopped tomato. When the tomato softens, add the beef mince and cubed potato. Mince cooks fairly quickly.

When the mince and potato are cooked through, add the green peas. Cook for 4–5 minutes, sprinkle roasted cumin powder over the top, and serve hot with paratha.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Eggplant Fry
item.description: A tasty eggplant fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make fried eggplant rounds easily.

Ingredients

  • Eggplant (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

First, wash the eggplant and cut it into thick rounds. Coat lightly with turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt, then deep-fry in hot oil until done. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Spiny Gourd Fry
item.description: A tasty spiny gourd fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a tasty spiny gourd fry easily.

Ingredients

  • Spiny gourd (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

First, wash the spiny gourd, peel it, and cut into long strips. Coat lightly with turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt, then deep-fry in hot oil until done. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Grill Chicken
item.description: A delicious grill chicken recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious grill chicken at home.

Ingredients

  • Whole chicken (1, about 1 kg)
  • Onion paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Ginger-garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Wash the chicken well, rub it with all the spices, and marinate for at least 4 hours. Marinating overnight in the refrigerator is even better.

Preheat the oven to 175°C (350°F) and bake the chicken for 40 minutes. Add a little water to the tray beneath the chicken so it does not dry out too much while grilling. Flip the chicken after 20 minutes.

After 40 minutes, remove the chicken from the oven and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Kosha Beef
item.description: Kosha beef curry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make kosha beef.

Ingredients

  • Beef (1 kg)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Star anise (1, optional)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Cut the beef into small pieces. Marinate with all the spices except onion, oil, and roasted cumin powder for 1 hour.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add the marinated beef mixture. Cook over medium heat. You do not need to add extra water at first; the beef will release its own juices and cook in them. If the liquid dries up before the beef is tender, add a little water.

When the beef is cooked and the liquid has evaporated, sprinkle roasted cumin powder over the top and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Crispy Laccha Semai
item.description: An easy recipe for crispy laccha semai
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for a delicious twist on laccha semai.

Ingredients

  • Laccha semai (200 g)
  • Milk powder (1 cup)
  • Ghee (2 tablespoons)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (1)
  • Raisins (for serving)
  • Cashews (for serving)

Method

First, wash the raisins well and soak them in water for 5 minutes. Heat ghee in a pot and fry the raisins and nuts, then set them aside.

In the same ghee, add the cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaf and fry the laccha semai over low heat until golden. Midway through frying, add the sugar and keep stirring constantly. Then add 1 cup of milk powder and mix well. About 1–2 minutes before removing from the heat, add the fried nuts and raisins and stir. Serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Green Mango and Kasundi Mash
item.description: A mouthwatering mash of raw mango and kasundi mustard
item.content:encoded:
Here is a delicious recipe for green mango mash with kasundi.

Ingredients

  • Green mangoes (3 / 250 g)
  • Green chilies (3–4)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Kasundi (2 tablespoons)
  • Sugar (1 tablespoon)

Method

Peel the green mangoes, wash them well, and cut them into thin slices. Mash them together with chopped green chilies, salt, sugar, and kasundi. Serve immediately.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Ridge Gourd and Prawn Curry
item.description: An easy recipe for ridge gourd and prawn curry
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for a simple but incredibly delicious ridge gourd and prawn curry.

Ingredients

  • Ridge gourd (500 g)
  • Green chilies (3–4)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Prawns (20–25)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the ridge gourd, peel it, and cut it into small pieces. Dust the prawns with a pinch of turmeric and shallow-fry them lightly in oil.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. Then add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Add the ridge gourd, pour in enough water, and cover. The gourd will soften quickly. Add the fried prawns and green chilies, stir for 2–3 minutes, and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Green Mango Mash
item.description: A mouthwatering green mango mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a mouthwatering recipe for green mango mash.

Ingredients

  • Green mangoes (3 / 250 g)
  • Green chilies (3–4)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Sugar (1 tablespoon)

Method

Wash the green mangoes, peel them, and finely chop or grate them on the coarse side of a box grater. Mash them together with chopped green chilies, salt, and sugar. Serve immediately.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Star Fruit Dal
item.description: A delicious star fruit dal recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is an incredibly tasty dal recipe with star fruit.

Ingredients

  • Lentils (1/2 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Star fruit (1)
  • Onion (1)
  • Garlic (1–2 cloves)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (1–2)
  • Cilantro (to taste)
  • Oil (2 tablespoons)
  • Panch phoron (1/2 teaspoon)

Method

In a pot, boil the washed lentils in enough water. Add 1 teaspoon of turmeric. When the lentils are cooked, season with salt and add the star fruit, cut in half, seeded, and washed, along with the green chilies. Take the pot off the heat once the star fruit softens.

Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan and fry the chopped onion, garlic, and panch phoron until golden. Pour the oil and fried aromatics into the cooked dal. Simmer for another 1–2 minutes. Add chopped cilantro just before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Fried Coconut Puli
item.description: A recipe for delicious fried coconut puli pitha
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make delicious fried coconut puli pitha.

Ingredients

  • Grated coconut (2 cups)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Rice flour (1.5 cups)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Cardamom (3)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (1)

Method

First, cook the grated coconut with the sugar, cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaf until the coconut is nicely fried. Remove from the heat and let it cool.

In a pot, combine the rice flour with 1 tablespoon of oil and enough water to make a dough. Roll the dough out thin like flatbread and cut it into small round pieces. Place coconut filling in the center of each round, fold the two edges together to close it, and seal the edges by pressing with a fork.

Finally, deep-fry until golden and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Potato Pinwheel
item.description: Make delicious potato pinwheels with ease
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make delicious potato pinwheels.

Ingredients

  • Potatoes (3)
  • All-purpose flour (1 cup)
  • Egg whites (2)
  • Semolina (1 tablespoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Panch phoron powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon, plus more for deep-frying)

Method

In a bowl, mix flour, semolina, and salt to taste. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and enough water to make a dough similar to roti dough. Rub with a little oil, cover, and rest for 1 hour.

Boil the potatoes, peel them, and mash. Mix in panch phoron powder, cumin powder, black pepper powder, chili powder, turmeric powder, and ginger paste until well combined.

Divide the dough into four portions and roll each out like a paratha. Spread the potato mixture evenly on top. Roll up tightly from one edge into a long log, then slice into pinwheels.

Dip the pinwheels in egg white and deep-fry until golden brown. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Beef Curry with Colocasia Stems
item.description: Beef curry with colocasia stems recipe
item.content:encoded:
Most of us love beef. Here is how to make beef curry with colocasia stems.

Ingredients

  • Beef (1 kg)
  • Colocasia stems (350 g)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Star anise (1, optional)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Cut 1 kg of beef into medium pieces and wash well. Peel the colocasia stems, cut them into small pieces, and set aside in a bowl.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add all the spices one by one except green chilies and roasted cumin powder. Watch that the spices do not burn; add a little water if needed. When the masala is fried, add the beef and cook well. Beef usually takes a little longer, so keep frying it properly.

When the beef is nearly tender, add water to your preferred curry consistency. Once the curry comes to a boil, add the colocasia stems and cook until both the beef and stems are fully done. Finish with green chilies and roasted cumin powder sprinkled over the top.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Prawn Dopeyaja
item.description: A recipe for prawn dopeyaja
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for delicious prawn dopeyaja.

Ingredients

  • Prawns (500 g)
  • Chopped onion (2 cups)
  • Turmeric powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Chili powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Coriander powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (5–6)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, clean and wash the prawns well, rub lightly with turmeric, shallow-fry, and set aside.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add all the spices except the green chilies and fry well, adding a little water if needed. Add the fried prawns and cook for 5–7 minutes. Just before serving, add green chilies sliced lengthwise.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Tengra Fish Curry with Bitter Gourd and Potato
item.description: A recipe for tengra fish curry with bitter gourd and potato
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for tengra fish curry with bitter gourd and potato.

Ingredients

  • Tengra fish (250 g)
  • Bitter gourd (150 g)
  • Potato (2)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the tengra fish, rub lightly with salt and turmeric, shallow-fry, and set aside.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt to taste. Add the cut potato and bitter gourd, stir briefly, and pour in enough water. When the potato and bitter gourd are tender, add the fried tengra fish. Cook 5–7 minutes more and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Red Amaranth Stir-fry
item.description: A tasty red amaranth stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a healthy red amaranth stir-fry recipe.

Ingredients

  • Red amaranth (500 grams)
  • Onion (1)
  • Garlic (3–4 cloves)
  • Dried chilies (3–4)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the red amaranth well and chop it finely. Boil until tender and drain thoroughly.

Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion, minced garlic, and dried chilies broken into pieces. When the onion softens, add the greens and salt to taste. Stir-fry well for 1–2 minutes, then take off the heat and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chicken Wrap
item.description: A recipe for a unique chicken wrap
item.content:encoded:
Let's learn how to make a delicious chicken wrap snack.

Ingredients

  • Boneless chicken (200 grams)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Ginger-garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Tomato sauce (1 teaspoon)
  • Soy sauce (1 teaspoon)
  • All-purpose flour (1 cup)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for deep-frying)

Method

First, wash the chicken and cut it into small pieces. Marinate with chili powder, salt, black pepper powder, ginger-garlic paste, tomato sauce, and soy sauce for 30 minutes.

Meanwhile, make a dough with flour, salt, and enough water. Roll it out and cut into long strips about 1.5 inches wide. Wrap each strip around a piece of chicken and secure with a toothpick. Deep-fry in hot oil until the chicken is fully cooked through. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Potato Wedges
item.description: Make delicious potato wedges with ease
item.content:encoded:
Let's look at how to make delicious potato wedges.

Ingredients

  • Potatoes (4)
  • All-purpose flour (1/2 cup)
  • Rice flour (1/4 cup)
  • Corn flour (1/4 cup)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Dried chilies (2)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for deep-frying)

Method

First, wash the potatoes well and cut them into large wedges with the skin on. Make sure each wedge has three corners. Bring a large pot of water to a boil with 1 tablespoon of salt. Add the potatoes and cook until about 70–80% done. Drain and let cool.

In a bowl, combine rice flour, corn flour, and all-purpose flour with salt to taste and mix well. Add dried chili flakes, turmeric powder, chili powder, garlic powder, and chopped cilantro and mix again. Add water to make a batter—it should be fairly thin. When you dip a potato wedge, it should get only a light coating.

Dip the par-cooked wedges in the batter and deep-fry until golden brown. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chepa Dried Fish Mash
item.description: A tasty chepa dried fish mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Living abroad, you always crave dried fish mash. Here is how to make chepa dried fish mash easily.

Ingredients

  • Chepa dried fish (3–4)
  • Onion (3–4)
  • Dried chilies (7–8)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, rinse the dried fish well, rub with salt, and cook in a pan with a very small amount of water until the liquid dries up — by then the fish should be tender. Take it off the heat and mash with dried chilies in a mortar and pestle. Peel 3–4 onions and mash them thoroughly. Mix the mashed onion with the fish mash and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Lemon Sherbet
item.description: A wonderfully delicious lemon sherbet recipe
item.content:encoded:
On a scorching day, a glass of lemon sherbet can be pure relief. Here is the recipe.

Ingredients

  • Paper lemons (2)
  • Water (500 ml)
  • Sugar (to taste)
  • Crushed ice (for serving)

Method

Squeeze the juice from 2 paper lemons into a bowl. Dissolve sugar to taste in 500 ml of water. Add the lemon juice and stir well. Serve ice cold over crushed ice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Green Chili Chop
item.description: A recipe for unique green chili chop
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for a distinctive green chili chop.

Ingredients

  • Green chilies (10–12)
  • Lemon juice (1/2 cup)
  • Soy sauce (1/2 cup)
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Wash the green chilies and pierce them several times with a toothpick. Be careful not to split them open — keeping them whole gives a better-looking chop. Soak them in a mixture of soy sauce and lemon juice for 1 hour.

For the batter, add 1 teaspoon turmeric powder and 1 teaspoon salt to the gram flour. Add enough water to make a mixture the consistency of pancake batter. Make sure there are no lumps. Deep-fry the soaked chilies in medium-hot oil after dipping them in the batter. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Tomato Chop
item.description: A recipe for delicious tomato chop
item.content:encoded:
Here is an easy recipe for tomato chop.

Ingredients

  • Tomatoes (2)
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Wash the tomatoes and slice them into thin rounds.

For the batter, add 1 teaspoon turmeric powder and 1 teaspoon salt to the gram flour. Add enough water to make a mixture the consistency of pancake batter. Make sure there are no lumps. Deep-fry the tomato slices in medium-hot oil after dipping them in the batter. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Bitter Melon Stir-fry
item.description: An easy bitter melon stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a simple white bitter melon stir-fry.

Ingredients

  • Bitter melon (250 grams)
  • Onion (1)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)
  • Green chilies (2–3)

Method

First, wash the bitter melon and cut it into thin rounds. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion softens slightly, add the bitter melon. Season with salt to taste. When the stir-fry is nearly done, add 2–3 green chilies split down the middle. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Semolina Halwa
item.description: A recipe for easy semolina halwa
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make semolina halwa, a classic breakfast item.

Ingredients

  • Semolina (1 cup)
  • Sugar (1/2 cup)
  • Chopped nuts (1 tablespoon)
  • Milk (1/2 liter)
  • Raisins (for serving)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (1)

Method

First, toast the semolina lightly in a pan over medium heat with the cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaf. Transfer it to a separate pot.

In a pot, heat the milk with the sugar. When it comes to a boil, add the toasted semolina. Then add the raisins. When the milk has reduced, remove from the heat. Serve topped with chopped nuts.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Ghugni
item.description: An easy recipe for ghugni
item.content:encoded:
Mention iftar and the school-gate vendor, and ghugni alone is enough to make your mouth water. Here is a simple recipe.

Ingredients

  • Dried yellow peas (1 cup)
  • Baking soda (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chopped onion (1)
  • Dried red chili flakes (1 teaspoon)
  • Chotpoti spice mix (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Chopped cucumber (for serving)
  • Chopped cilantro (for serving)
  • Chopped scallions (for serving)

Method

Rinse the peas and soak them overnight with 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. Drain, rinse again, and boil in plenty of water. As they cook, loose skins will float to the top — skim them off with a spoon. When the peas are tender, reduce the liquid until the mixture reaches your preferred thickness.

In a bowl, combine the cooked peas with salt, chotpoti spice mix, and chopped onion. Serve topped with chopped cucumber, scallions, cilantro, and dried red chili flakes.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Red Lentil Mash
item.description: An easy but incredibly tasty red lentil mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a very easy but incredibly tasty red lentil mash recipe.

Ingredients

  • Red lentils (1 cup)
  • Onion (1)
  • Green chilies (3–4)
  • Garlic (2 cloves)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Mustard oil (1 teaspoon)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Dried chili (1)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, rinse the lentils and boil until tender with 1 green chili, 1 teaspoon turmeric powder, and 2 garlic cloves, then mash well. In a bowl, mash together diced green chilies, chopped cilantro, salt, onion, and mustard oil. Add the mashed lentils and mix thoroughly. Fry the remaining dried chili, crush it by hand, and sprinkle over the top before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Flattened Rice Dessert
item.description: A recipe for a delicious dessert made with flattened rice
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a delicious flattened-rice dessert with just a few simple ingredients.

Ingredients

  • Flattened rice (chira) (150 g)
  • Milk (1/2 liter)
  • Sugar (2 tablespoons)
  • Apple (1)
  • Banana (1)
  • Dates (4–5)
  • Dried apricots (3–4)
  • Raisins (for serving)
  • Cashews (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, soak the flattened rice in water for 30 minutes, then drain. In a pot, heat the milk with the sugar, then let it cool. Slice the banana and apple. Add the cold milk to the soaked flattened rice. Top with the sliced banana and apple. Garnish with sliced dates, raisins, chopped cashews, and dried apricots, then serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Ginger Lemon Vegetable Thai Soup
item.description: Easily make ginger lemon vegetable Thai soup with Maggi soup mix
item.content:encoded:
Let's easily make restaurant-style ginger lemon vegetable Thai soup using Maggi soup mix.

Ingredients

  • Maggi soup mix (1 packet)
  • Butter (100 grams)
  • Mushrooms (1 cup)
  • Shrimp (150 grams)
  • Chopped ginger (1 tablespoon)
  • Lemon (1)
  • Onion (1)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Kaffir lime leaves (2)
  • Tomato (1)
  • Carrot (1)
  • Green beans (1/2 cup)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, dissolve 1 packet of Maggi soup mix in 500 ml of water and let it sit for 10 minutes.

In a pot, melt the butter and add peeled shrimp. When the shrimp turn pink, add an onion cut into four wedges. Add the carrot, mushrooms, chopped ginger, and green beans and sauté for about 3 minutes. Pour in the dissolved soup mix and add salt to taste.

Once it comes to a boil, add chopped tomato and green chilies. Cook for 5–7 minutes. Finish with the zest of one lemon, lemon juice, and 2 kaffir lime leaves. Cook for 2 more minutes, then serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Potato Chips
item.description: Make delicious potato chips quickly and easily
item.content:encoded:
Here is a quick and easy recipe for crispy, delicious potato chips.

Ingredients

  • Potatoes (2)
  • Chaat masala (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

First, peel the potatoes and slice them thinly into rounds. Soak the slices in water for 10 minutes. This removes excess starch and helps the chips turn out crisp. Drain and pat them dry well.

Heat oil in a pan and fry the potato slices until golden brown. While they are still hot, sprinkle with salt and chaat masala, then serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chapila Fish Bhuna
item.description: A recipe for chapila fish bhuna
item.content:encoded:
Here is a quick look at how to make chapila fish bhuna.

Ingredients

  • Chapila fish (500 g)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Chili powder (2 teaspoons)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (5–6)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, scale the chapila fish, rub lightly with salt and turmeric, and shallow-fry.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add all the spices except the green chilies and fry well, adding a little water if needed. Add the fried chapila fish and cook for 5–7 minutes. Just before serving, add green chilies sliced lengthwise.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Okra Stir-fry
item.description: An easy and tasty okra stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make okra stir-fry very easily.

Ingredients

  • Okra (250 grams)
  • Onion (1)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, wash the okra and cut it into small pieces. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion softens slightly, add salt to taste. Add the cut okra and keep stirring continuously. Okra cooks quickly and does not take long. Do not cover the pan — that will ruin the color of the okra. Add green chilies split down the middle 1–2 minutes before taking off the heat.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Egg Mash
item.description: A tasty egg mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make egg mash easily.

Ingredients

  • Eggs (3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Dried chilies (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Mustard oil (1 teaspoon)

Method

First, boil the eggs, peel them, and grate them. If you do not have a grater, you can chop or mash them by hand. In a bowl, mash together diced onion, fried dried chilies, salt, and mustard oil. Add the eggs and mix well. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Lemon Rui Fish
item.description: A recipe for rui fish cooked with lemon
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for rui fish cooked with lemon.

Ingredients

  • Rui fish (250 g)
  • Lemon (1)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Ginger paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (5–6)
  • Kaffir lime leaves (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, rub the rui fish lightly with turmeric and poach it in a little water. Remove the bones and set the fish aside in a bowl.

Heat oil in a pan and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add turmeric, chili powder, ginger paste, garlic paste, and salt. When the spices are fried, add the deboned poached fish and cook for 5–7 minutes. Two minutes before taking the pan off the heat, add green chilies, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, some lemon zest, and 2–3 kaffir lime leaves.

Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Beguni
item.description: An easy recipe for beguni
item.content:encoded:
Beguni is an essential part of iftar. Here is an easy recipe for making it at home.

Ingredients

  • Long eggplant (1)
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Finely chopped onion (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Wash the eggplant and slice it thinly lengthwise.

For the batter, add 1 teaspoon turmeric powder, 1 teaspoon salt, chopped onion, and chopped green chilies to the gram flour. Add enough water to make a mixture the consistency of pancake batter. Make sure there are no lumps. Deep-fry the eggplant slices in medium-hot oil after dipping them in the batter. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Egg Chop
item.description: A recipe for making egg chop
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for classic Bengali egg chop.

Ingredients

  • Eggs (4)
  • Potatoes (2–3 large)
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Finely chopped onion (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Boil the potatoes and mash them with salt, green chilies, and chopped onion. Hard-boil the eggs and peel them. Wrap each egg in a thin layer of potato mash, making sure no egg shows through.

For the batter, add 1 teaspoon turmeric powder and 1 teaspoon salt to the gram flour. Add enough water to make a mixture the consistency of pancake batter. Make sure there are no lumps. Deep-fry the chops in medium-hot oil after dipping them in the batter. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Crispy Bitter Melon Fry
item.description: An easy crispy bitter melon fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Bitter melon is a very healthy food. Here is a different take — crispy bitter melon fry.

Ingredients

  • Bitter melon (250 grams)
  • Rice flour (1 tablespoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

First, wash the bitter melon and cut it into moderately thick rounds. Mix in turmeric powder, chili powder, rice flour, and salt until evenly coated. Deep-fry in hot oil until crisp.

Serve hot with rice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Egg Semai
item.description: An incredibly delicious recipe for egg semai
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make incredibly delicious egg semai.

Ingredients

  • Eggs (2)
  • Milk (1/2 liter)
  • Sugar (1 cup)
  • Raisins (for serving)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (1)
  • Chopped nuts (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, beat the eggs well in a bowl and set them aside.

In a pot, heat the milk with the sugar, cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaf. When it comes to a boil, lower the heat. Slowly add the beaten eggs to the milk while whisking constantly. Cook over low heat until the eggs are set and the mixture has thickened. Serve topped with chopped nuts and raisins.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Doi Bora
item.description: An easy recipe for doi bora made with semolina
item.content:encoded:
The name doi bora alone is enough to make your mouth water. Here is how to make this delicious snack easily with semolina.

Ingredients

  • Sour yogurt (750 g)
  • Semolina (1 cup)
  • Red chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chaat masala (1 teaspoon)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Ginger paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Tamarind sauce (for serving)
  • Cilantro-green chili paste (for serving)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Chopped mint (1 teaspoon)
  • Black salt (1 teaspoon)

Method

First, make the dressing. In a bowl, mix 500 g sour yogurt with red chili powder, roasted cumin powder, chaat masala, and black salt. Cover and set aside.

For the fritters, combine semolina, 250 g sour yogurt, and 1 cup water in a bowl. Cover and rest for 30 minutes. Then add ginger paste, garlic paste, chopped green chilies, and chopped mint. Mix well. Deep-fry spoonfuls in hot oil until lightly golden, shaped like pakoras or fritters. Let them cool completely.

In another bowl, mix 1 teaspoon salt into 1/2 liter water. Soak the fried fritters in this water for 10 minutes.

After 10 minutes, gently squeeze out the water and transfer the fritters to the serving bowl. Pour the yogurt dressing over the top. Finish with tamarind sauce, cilantro-green chili paste, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro. Serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Wood Apple Sherbet
item.description: A wonderfully delicious wood apple sherbet recipe
item.content:encoded:
Wood apple sherbet is wonderfully cooling in the heat, and it is good for digestion too. Here is a very easy way to make it.

Ingredients

  • Wood apple (1)
  • Lemon (1)
  • Water (500 ml)
  • Sugar (to taste)
  • Crushed ice (for serving)

Method

Break open a ripe wood apple and mash the pulp into 250 ml of water. Discard the seeds and fibers. Strain the mixture, then add the remaining 250 ml of water and the juice of 1 lemon. Sweeten with sugar to taste and stir well. Serve ice cold with crushed ice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Semolina Fritters
item.description: A recipe for delicious semolina fritters
item.content:encoded:
Today I am sharing a slightly unusual but very easy recipe for semolina fritters. Let us get started.

Ingredients

  • Semolina (1 cup)
  • Egg (1)
  • Onion (1)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Chopped mint (1 tablespoon)
  • Chopped tomato (1)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

In a bowl, combine the semolina with 1 egg and a little water. Let it rest for 15 minutes so the semolina absorbs the liquid and softens. Mix in all the remaining ingredients. Deep-fry spoonfuls over medium heat until golden brown. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Ash Gourd Stir-fry
item.description: An easy ash gourd stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make ash gourd stir-fry very easily.

Ingredients

  • Ash gourd (1)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, wash the ash gourd and grate it. You can also dice it finely if you prefer. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. Add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt, stir well, then add the ash gourd. Keep stirring, then cover after a few minutes.

You do not need to add extra water — the ash gourd will release plenty of moisture and cook in its own juices. Wait until the liquid dries up. When it is nearly dry, add a few green chilies split down the middle. Take off the heat after 2–3 minutes.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Okra Mash
item.description: An easy and tasty okra mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make okra mash very easily.

Ingredients

  • Okra (250 grams)
  • Onion (1)
  • Dried chilies (4–5)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Mustard oil (1 teaspoon)

Method

First, wash the okra and cut it into medium-sized pieces. Boil the okra until tender and drain well. Mash it thoroughly and set aside in a bowl.

Heat oil in a pan and fry the dried chilies until crisp. Mash together diced onion, mustard oil, fried dried chilies, and salt. Add the prepared okra and mix until well combined.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Rooh Afza Sherbet
item.description: A wonderfully delicious Rooh Afza sherbet recipe
item.content:encoded:
Rooh Afza is a very refreshing drink. Here is how to make sherbet with it.

Ingredients

  • Rooh Afza (2 tablespoons)
  • Sugar (to taste)
  • Lemon juice (1 teaspoon)
  • Crushed ice (for serving)

Method

In a bowl, combine 500 ml of water with 2 tablespoons of Rooh Afza, 1 teaspoon of lemon juice, and sugar to taste. Stir well. Serve ice cold over crushed ice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Mediterranean Dish: Shakshouka
item.description: A recipe for shakshouka, a traditional Middle Eastern dish
item.content:encoded:
Shakshouka is a traditional and popular Middle Eastern breakfast dish. Let's learn how to make it easily.

Ingredients

  • Eggs (3)
  • Olive oil (2 tablespoons)
  • Onion (1)
  • Chopped tomatoes (3)
  • Chopped red bell pepper (1/3 cup)
  • Chopped green bell pepper (1/3 cup)
  • Chopped yellow bell pepper (1/3 cup)
  • Chopped mushrooms (1/2 cup)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Black pepper powder (1/2 teaspoon)

Method

Heat olive oil in a pan and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add turmeric powder, chili powder, salt, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Add chopped tomatoes, mushrooms, bell peppers, and green chilies. Cook until everything is soft and tender.

Crack 3 eggs on top of the mixture. Do not stir after adding the eggs. Cover and cook over low heat until the eggs are set. Sprinkle black pepper powder over the eggs and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Croatian Kebab: Ćevapčići
item.description: Easily make ćevapčići, a popular Balkan kebab
item.content:encoded:
I got this recipe from my Croatian colleague Jan. It is very popular across the Balkans in Europe. Let's look at the recipe—it is essentially a skinless sausage, also known as ćevapi.

Ingredients

  • Ground beef (500 grams)
  • Chopped onion (1)
  • Chopped garlic (1 teaspoon)
  • Black pepper powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Baking soda (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

Mix all ingredients except the oil thoroughly in a bowl. Take portions of the mixture and shape them into long sausage-like kebabs.

Heat oil in a pan and fry the kebabs over medium heat. You can also grill them if you prefer. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Beef Stew
item.description: White beef stew recipe
item.content:encoded:
This is my mother's recipe — my favorite beef dish. Served hot with paratha, it feels like heaven on a plate. Here is the recipe.

Ingredients

  • Beef (1 kg)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Whole dried chilies (8–10)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Star anise (1, optional)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Cut the beef into small pieces. Lightly pound the meat with a meat mallet. If you do not have one, you can pound it with a mortar pestle or any heavy object. Marinate the beef with all the spices except onion and roasted cumin powder for 1 hour.

Heat oil in a pot. When the oil is hot, add the marinated beef mixture. Cook over medium heat. You do not need to add extra water at first; the beef will release its own juices and cook in them. If the liquid dries up before the beef is tender, add a little water.

When the beef is cooked and the liquid has evaporated, sprinkle roasted cumin powder over the top and serve hot with paratha.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Cabbage Stir-fry
item.description: A delicious and healthy cabbage stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Cabbage is a very healthy vegetable. Here is how to make cabbage stir-fry very easily.

Ingredients

  • Shredded cabbage (2 cups)
  • Onion (1)
  • Cilantro (for serving)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, remove the outer leaves of the cabbage, wash it, shred it finely, and drain. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion turns lightly golden, add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt, and stir once. Add the shredded cabbage. Cabbage cooks very quickly. When tender, split a few green chilies down the middle and add them. Sprinkle cilantro just before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Rui Fish Curry with Hyacinth Beans and Potato
item.description: A recipe for rui fish curry with hyacinth beans, tomato, and potato
item.content:encoded:
Rui fish curry with winter vegetables makes a wonderful dish. Here is an easy recipe to learn.

Ingredients

  • Rui fish (6 pieces)
  • Tomato (3)
  • Hyacinth beans (10–15)
  • Potato (2)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Cilantro (for serving)

Method

First, wash the rui fish pieces, rub lightly with turmeric, shallow-fry in oil, and set aside.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Add medium-sized cubed tomato, peeled hyacinth beans cut in half, and long potato slices. Stir lightly and add 1 cup water. The potato and beans will soften quickly and the tomato will break down into a coating gravy. Add the fried fish and green chilies and cook 2–3 minutes more. Finish with cilantro and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Egg Omelet
item.description: An easy recipe for egg omelet
item.content:encoded:
An omelet is a breakfast staple. Here is an easy recipe for a delicious one.

Ingredients

  • Eggs (2)
  • Finely chopped onion (1 tablespoon)
  • Chopped scallions (1 teaspoon)
  • Chopped red bell pepper (1 teaspoon)
  • Chopped green bell pepper (1 teaspoon)
  • Chopped yellow bell pepper (1 teaspoon)
  • Chopped green chilies (2)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Butter (50 g)

Method

Combine all the chopped vegetables in a bowl with salt to taste and mash them lightly with your hands. Crack in 2 eggs and mix well.

Melt butter in a pan. Pour in the egg mixture and cook over medium heat. When one side sets, flip and cook the other side. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Watermelon Sherbet
item.description: A wonderfully delicious watermelon sherbet recipe
item.content:encoded:
Watermelon sherbet is wonderfully refreshing in the heat. Here is a very easy way to make it.

Ingredients

  • Watermelon (150 g)
  • Water (100 ml)
  • Sugar (to taste)
  • Crushed ice (for serving)

Method

Blend diced watermelon with cold water until smooth. Add sugar to taste if you like. Serve chilled over crushed ice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Prawn Polao
item.description: An incredibly delicious prawn polao recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make prawn polao quickly using Radhuni biryani mix.

Ingredients

  • Prawns (200 g)
  • Polao rice (1 cup)
  • Oil (1 cup)
  • Radhuni biryani mix (2 tablespoons)
  • Green chilies (6–7)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Sour yogurt (150 g)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Onion (1 cup)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)

Method

Rub the prawns lightly with salt and turmeric and fry them briefly. In a pan, heat oil and add some chopped onion. When the onion softens, add ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, and biryani masala. Cook well. After a few minutes, add sour yogurt and salt. When the masala is well fried, add the fried prawns and cook for another 2–3 minutes. Set aside.

In another pot, heat oil with the remaining chopped onion, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and bay leaves. When the onion softens, add the polao rice and fry well. When the rice is toasted, add water. For 1 cup of rice, I use 3 cups of water. When the rice is nearly cooked, add the prepared prawns and their gravy. Stir well and cook until the water is fully absorbed. Add 6–7 whole green chilies, stir, and let it steam on dum for 10 minutes. During those 10 minutes, gently turn the prawn polao over 3–4 times. Your delicious prawn polao is ready.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Jilapi
item.description: An easy recipe for traditional jilapi
item.content:encoded:
Iftar feels incomplete without jilapi. And the thought of hot jilapi from a street stall is enough to make your mouth water. Here is how to make jilapi very easily.

Ingredients

  • Rice flour (1 cup)
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Sour yogurt (1 tablespoon)
  • Baking powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Sugar (3 cups)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (1)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

First, make the sugar syrup. In a pot, combine 3 cups of sugar, 1 cup of water, the cardamom, cinnamon, and bay leaf and bring it to a boil. Cook until the sugar dissolves completely.

Mix the rice flour, gram flour, and baking powder well. Add 1 tablespoon of sour yogurt. Slowly add water to make a batter. Make sure the batter is neither too thick nor too thin. Fill a sauce dispenser with the batter. If you do not have one at home, put all the batter into one corner of a square plastic bag and snip off a tiny bit of the corner so it works like a dispenser.

Deep-fry the batter over medium heat, shaping each portion into a jilapi. When they are lightly golden, soak them in the prepared sugar syrup for 4–5 minutes. Transfer to a dish and serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Mango Lassi
item.description: A wonderfully delicious mango lassi recipe
item.content:encoded:
Nothing compares to lassi on a hot day or at iftar—and mango lassi is even better. Here is a very easy recipe.

Ingredients

  • Sweet yogurt (2 tablespoons)
  • Mango (100 g)
  • Cold water (as needed)
  • Sugar (to taste)
  • Crushed ice (for serving)

Method

Blend the yogurt, diced mango, and cold water until smooth. Add sugar to taste if you like. Serve chilled over crushed ice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chicken Roast
item.description: An incredibly delicious chicken roast recipe
item.content:encoded:
When you think of wedding food, chicken roast is one of the first dishes that comes to mind. Here is how to make an easy and flavorful roast using Radhuni roast masala.

Ingredients

  • Chicken on the bone (1 kg)
  • Radhuni roast masala (1 packet or 35 g)
  • Onion paste (2 tablespoons)
  • Sour yogurt (2 tablespoons or 125 g)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (5–6)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)

Method

First, fry most of the chopped onion in oil until golden brown and set the beresta aside. Rub the meat lightly with turmeric and fry it in oil.

In a pot, heat oil with a little chopped onion, onion paste, ginger paste, and garlic paste. After a minute or two, add all of the Radhuni roast masala. Cook for 2–3 minutes, then add sour yogurt and salt to taste. When the masala is well fried, add the fried chicken and cook until fully tender. Add 5–6 green chilies. Just before taking it off the heat, stir in the fried onion. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Black Cumin Mash
item.description: An easy black cumin mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Black cumin mash is uniquely flavorful and very healthy. Here is a very easy recipe.

Ingredients

  • Black cumin (100 grams)
  • Garlic (1 large head)
  • Dried chilies (5–6)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, lightly toast the black cumin in a pan. Do not over-fry it, or the mash will turn bitter.

Peel one large head of garlic and fry it in oil along with 5–6 dried chilies. Grind the black cumin, fried garlic, and dried chilies with salt to taste in a mortar and pestle. I do not have a mortar, so I used a spice grinder — a hand blender works too.

Serve and enjoy.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Potato Chop
item.description: A recipe for making potato chop
item.content:encoded:
Iftar never feels complete without potato chop. Here is an easy recipe for making it at home.

Ingredients

  • Potatoes (2 large)
  • Gram flour (besan) (1 cup)
  • Finely chopped onion (1 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (for frying)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, boil the potatoes. Mash them with salt, green chilies, and chopped onion. Shape the mash into small chops like in the photos.

For the batter, add 1 teaspoon turmeric powder and 1 teaspoon salt to the gram flour. Add enough water to make a mixture the consistency of pancake batter. Make sure there are no lumps. Deep-fry the chops in medium-hot oil after dipping them in the batter. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Sweet Recipe: Gulab Jamun
item.description: A recipe for gulab jamun
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make incredibly delicious traditional gulab jamun.

Ingredients

  • Chhana (1 cup)
  • All-purpose flour (1 tablespoon)
  • Sugar (1.25 cups)
  • Cardamom (2)
  • Cinnamon (2 sticks)
  • Bay leaf (1)
  • Rose water (1 tablespoon)
  • Ghee (1 tablespoon)
  • Oil (for frying)

Method

First, make chhana from 1 liter of milk. You can find the chhana recipe here.

To make the sugar syrup, cook the sugar with 1 glass (250 ml) of water along with the cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf, and rose water until the sugar dissolves completely. Transfer it to a bowl.

For the sweets, knead the chhana, flour, and 1 tablespoon of ghee very well. Make sure there are no lumps left. Shape the mixture into small balls.

Heat oil in a pot and fry the sweets over medium heat. If you deep-fry them, they will float to the top within a few minutes. Keep frying until they are golden brown.

Once fried, soak the sweets in the sugar syrup for at least 1 hour. Then serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Mango Milkshake
item.description: A wonderfully delicious mango milkshake recipe
item.content:encoded:
Mango milkshake is one of my favorite drinks. Here is the recipe.

Ingredients

  • Milk (3/4 glass or 200 ml)
  • Mango (1/2 cup)
  • Sugar (to taste)
  • Ice (for serving)

Method

Heat the milk, then chill it completely. Add the milk to a blender along with the mango pieces. Blend well with sugar to taste. You can skip the sugar if you prefer.

Serve over crushed ice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Beef Bhuna with Mung Dal
item.description: Beef bhuna with mung dal recipe
item.content:encoded:
Nothing compares to beef bhuna with mung dal and paratha. Here is the recipe.

Ingredients

  • Beef (1 kg)
  • Mung dal (1.5 cups)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Star anise (1, optional)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Dry-roast the mung dal in a pan, taking care not to burn it. Let it cool, then soak in water for 30 minutes. Drain and set aside in a bowl.

Cut the beef into medium pieces and wash well. Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add all the spices one by one except green chilies and roasted cumin powder. Watch that the spices do not burn; add a little water if needed. When the masala is fried, add the beef and cook well. Beef usually takes a little longer, so keep frying it properly.

When the beef is nearly tender, add water to your preferred consistency. Then add the mung dal and cook until both are done. Add green chilies 4–5 minutes before finishing. Sprinkle roasted cumin powder over the top before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chola
item.description: A recipe for cooking chola
item.content:encoded:
Chola is an essential part of iftar during Ramadan. Here is how to cook it.

Ingredients

  • Dried yellow peas (chola) (1 cup)
  • Onions (2)
  • Potato (1)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Green cardamom (3)
  • Cinnamon (3 pieces)
  • Cloves (3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Cilantro (for serving)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Oil (as needed)

Method

Soak the chola overnight in water — I usually soak them for 24 hours. Drain, rinse, and boil in fresh water until tender. Chola takes a long time to cook, so plan accordingly. Separately, boil potato cubes until soft.

Heat oil in a pan and add chopped onion. When the onion begins to soften, add all the spices except the green chilies and cilantro. Add a little water if needed so the spices do not burn. Add the boiled potato and chola. Cook for 10–12 minutes, then add the green chilies and cook 2–3 minutes more. Sprinkle with cilantro just before serving.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Bengali-Style Vegetable Pasta
item.description: A recipe for mixed vegetable pasta with Bengali flavors
item.content:encoded:
Here is a fully Bengali-style mixed vegetable pasta recipe.

Ingredients

  • Fusilli pasta (200 g)
  • Broccoli (1 cup)
  • Carrots (2)
  • Potato (1)
  • Tomato (1)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Onion (1)
  • Zucchini (1/4 cup)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Red chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Olive oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 1 teaspoon salt. Add the pasta and cook according to the package directions, usually 10–12 minutes.

Boil all the vegetables except the tomato and zucchini. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a pan and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt. Stir, then add the boiled vegetables along with diced tomato and zucchini. Cook until the tomato breaks down — the zucchini will cook through in that time.

Crack in 2 eggs and stir. Add the pasta and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Spicy Egg Pitha
item.description: A very easy and delicious spicy egg pitha
item.content:encoded:
Spicy egg pitha is also known as jhal poya pitha to many. Here is the recipe.

Ingredients

  • Rice flour (1 cup)
  • All-purpose flour (1/4 cup)
  • Egg (1)
  • Onion (1)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Red chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

Mix the rice flour, all-purpose flour, turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt together. Crack in 1 egg. Add water a little at a time to make a batter the consistency of pancake batter. Stir in chopped green chilies and onion.

Deep-fry the pitha one at a time over medium heat until golden. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Fenugreek Shing Fish Curry
item.description: A recipe for shing fish curry with fenugreek
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make shing fish curry with fenugreek.

Ingredients

  • Shing fish (500 g)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Ginger-garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Fenugreek (1 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, cut the shing fish into pieces and wash well. Heat oil in a pot and add fenugreek and chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Keep frying the spices, adding a little water if needed so they do not burn. When the spices are ready, add the shing fish and fry briefly, then pour in enough water. Shing fish cooks quickly, so it does not need long simmering.

Cook for 5–7 minutes, then add whole green chilies. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Tomato Rui Fish Curry
item.description: A recipe for rui fish curry with tomato and potato
item.content:encoded:
Rui fish curry is a wonderful dish. Here is an easy recipe to learn.

Ingredients

  • Rui fish (6 pieces)
  • Tomato (3)
  • Potato (2)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Cilantro (for serving)

Method

First, wash the rui fish pieces, rub lightly with turmeric, shallow-fry in oil, and set aside.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens, add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Add medium-sized cubed tomato and long potato slices. Stir lightly and add 1 cup water. The potato will soften quickly and the tomato will break down into a coating gravy. Add the fried fish and green chilies and cook 2–3 minutes more.

Finish with cilantro and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Red Lentil and Jute Leaf Fritters
item.description: A recipe for fritters made with red lentils and jute leaves
item.content:encoded:
Here is an easy recipe for red lentil fritters with jute leaves.

Ingredients

  • Red lentils (1 cup)
  • Chopped jute leaves (2 cups)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Green chilies (2–3)

Method

Wash the red lentils and soak them in water for at least 6 hours. For best results, soak them overnight so the lentils swell. Grind the lentils in a mortar or blend them. If the lentils are very soft, you can also mash them well by hand instead of blending.

Wash the jute leaves and chop them finely. Mix in all the remaining ingredients and shape the mixture into patties.

Deep-fry in hot oil and serve while still hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Salad
item.description: A very simple but healthy salad recipe
item.content:encoded:
Most of us eat salad from time to time. Here is an easy recipe for making one at home.

Ingredients

  • Cucumber (1)
  • Tomato (2)
  • Carrot (1)
  • Iceberg lettuce (1 cup)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the tomatoes and cucumber and slice them thinly. Peel the carrot and cut it into long strips. Wash the iceberg lettuce and cut it into small pieces. Finely chop the onion and green chilies.

In a bowl, add the chopped onion and green chilies with a little salt and rub them together with your fingers. Add the remaining ingredients, toss well, and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Hyacinth Bean and Potato Mash
item.description: An easy and tasty hyacinth bean and potato mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a tasty hyacinth bean and potato mash.

Ingredients

  • Hyacinth beans (250 grams)
  • Potato (2 large)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1 large)
  • Cilantro (2 tablespoons)
  • Mustard oil (1 tablespoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the hyacinth beans and boil until tender. Mash them in a mortar and pestle. I do not have a mortar, so I blended them in a blender. Add onion, green chilies, and salt while blending.

Boil the potatoes separately, peel, and mash well. Transfer the bean mash from the blender, add a little mustard oil and chopped cilantro, mix in the mashed potato, and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Tomato and Potato Mash
item.description: Learn an easy and tasty tomato and potato mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a very easy tomato and potato mash recipe.

Ingredients

  • Tomato (4–5)
  • Potato (2 large)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1 large)
  • Cilantro (2 tablespoons)
  • Mustard oil (1 tablespoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the tomatoes, dice them, and put them in a pan over the heat. Cook until fully softened — within a few minutes all the tomatoes will break down. Mash any large pieces with a spatula. When the tomato juices have reduced, transfer to a bowl.

Boil the potatoes separately, peel, and mash well.

In the bowl, add diced onion, chopped cilantro, diced green chilies, mustard oil, and salt, and mash together well. Combine thoroughly with the cooked tomatoes and mashed potato, and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Lassi
item.description: A wonderfully delicious lassi recipe
item.content:encoded:
Nothing compares to lassi on a hot day or at iftar. Here is a very easy recipe.

Ingredients

  • Sweet yogurt (2 tablespoons)
  • Cold water (as needed)
  • Sugar (to taste)
  • Crushed ice (for serving)

Method

Blend the yogurt with cold water until smooth. Add sugar to taste if you like. Serve chilled over crushed ice.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Potato Mash
item.description: A tasty potato mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a simple, everyday potato mash recipe.

Ingredients

  • Potato (500 grams)
  • Onion (1)
  • Cilantro (for serving)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon)

Method

First, wash and boil the potatoes until tender. Peel and mash them well. Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion. When the onion turns lightly golden, add the mashed potato, green chilies, cilantro, and salt to taste. Stir-fry until done, then take off the heat and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Mughlai Paratha
item.description: A recipe for the beloved Bengali snack mughlai paratha
item.content:encoded:
When I lived in Bangladesh, I often had mughlai paratha at a hotel in the afternoon. Since that is not an option here, let us make this delicious snack at home.

Ingredients

  • All-purpose flour (1 cup)
  • Eggs (2)
  • Onion (1)
  • Green chilies (2)
  • Chopped cilantro (1 tablespoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chaat masala (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Oil (1 tablespoon, plus more for frying)

Method

Add a little salt and 1 tablespoon oil to 1 cup flour. Knead with water a little at a time until you have a smooth dough. The more you knead, the better the gluten develops and the prettier the paratha will be. Once the dough is ready, rub it with a little oil, cover, and rest for 10 minutes.

In a bowl, beat 2 eggs with chopped onion, cilantro, green chilies, garam masala, and chaat masala. Chaat masala is optional if you do not have it at home.

Roll the dough into one large thin roti. Spread the egg mixture in the center, fold in the edges from all sides, and shape it into a paratha. Deep-fry over low heat — keep the flame moderate so the inside cooks through without the outside burning.

Fry until golden brown. Cut into small pieces like they do at the shops and serve hot with tomato sauce and salad.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Malabar Spinach Stir-fry
item.description: Malabar spinach stir-fry recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is a wonderfully tasty malabar spinach stir-fry.

Ingredients

  • Malabar spinach (500 grams)
  • Dried chilies (3–4)
  • Onion (1)
  • Garlic (2–3 cloves)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the malabar spinach. Put it in a large pot over the heat — within a short while it will wilt down considerably and cook through. Set the cooked spinach aside.

Heat oil in a pan and add diced onion, minced garlic, salt, and dried chilies. When the onion is nearly fried, add the spinach. Stir-fry for 1–2 minutes, then take off the heat.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Baila Fish Curry with Tomato
item.description: A recipe for baila fish curry with tomato
item.content:encoded:
For those who love small fish, here is baila fish curry with tomato.

Ingredients

  • Tomato (3–4)
  • Baila fish (250 g)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the baila fish thoroughly. Small fish always need a very good rinse.

Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. Then add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Add cubed tomato, then immediately add the baila fish with a little water and cover. Baila fish cooks quickly, and the tomatoes will release more liquid. When the gravy has mostly reduced and coats the curry, add green chilies and cook 2–3 minutes more. Serve hot.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Salmon Curry with Eggplant
item.description: A recipe for salmon curry with potato and eggplant
item.content:encoded:
Here is a recipe for salmon curry with potato and eggplant.

Ingredients

  • Eggplant (2)
  • Potato (2)
  • Salmon (2 fillets, 250 g)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1)
  • Turmeric powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, cut and wash the salmon, rub lightly with turmeric, and shallow-fry over low heat. Set aside.

Cube the eggplant and potato and wash them. Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. Then add turmeric powder, chili powder, and salt. Add the potato and eggplant and cook covered. The moisture released from the eggplant should be enough to soften both vegetables; add a little water only if needed.

Add the fried salmon and green chilies and cook 2–3 minutes more. Serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Chicken Jhal Masala
item.description: Chicken jhal masala recipe
item.content:encoded:
Nothing compares to chicken jhal masala with paratha. Here is the recipe.

Ingredients

  • Chicken (500 g)
  • Turmeric powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Chili powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cumin powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Coriander powder (1/2 teaspoon)
  • Garam masala powder (1 teaspoon)
  • Cardamom (4)
  • Cinnamon (4 pieces)
  • Cloves (4)
  • Bay leaves (2)
  • Star anise (1, optional)
  • Salt (to taste)
  • Green chilies (4–5)
  • Chopped onion (1 cup)
  • Ginger paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Garlic paste (1 teaspoon)
  • Oil (1/2 cup)
  • Roasted cumin powder (1 teaspoon)

Method

Wash the chicken and cut it into small pieces. Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion. When the onion softens slightly, add all the spices one by one except green chilies and roasted cumin powder. Watch that the spices do not burn; add a little water if needed. When the masala is fried, add the chicken and cook well. Chicken cooks fairly quickly, so keep frying until tender.

Add green chilies and a little water. When the liquid has mostly reduced, sprinkle roasted cumin powder over the top and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Hyacinth Bean Mash
item.description: An easy and tasty hyacinth bean mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Here is how to make a tasty hyacinth bean mash.

Ingredients

  • Hyacinth beans (250 grams)
  • Green chilies (2–3)
  • Onion (1 large)
  • Cilantro (2 tablespoons)
  • Mustard oil (1 tablespoon)
  • Salt (to taste)

Method

First, wash the hyacinth beans and boil until tender. Mash them in a mortar and pestle. I do not have a mortar, so I blended them in a blender. Add onion, green chilies, and salt while blending.

Transfer from the blender, mix in a little mustard oil and chopped cilantro, and serve.
item.author: Milon

item.title: Tomato Mash
item.description: Learn an easy and tasty tomato mash recipe
item.content:encoded:
Tomato is one of my favorite vegetables. Here is how to make tomato mash.

Ingredients

  • Tomato (4–5)
